overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
full_list.title_zh: 具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验和灵活性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across ν=1/5, 1/3, and 2/5, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。因此，我们提出了轨道对矩阵因子 MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz，它不仅用可学习的对因子替换固定的 Laughlin 结构，而且使它们依赖于电子构型和轨道，从而平衡物理先验与灵活性。在 ν=1/5、1/3 和 2/5 范围内，MHPO-M 在测试的变体中实现了最低的变分能量，并且基于它的因式分解轨道读数可以扩展到 35 个电子，其能量与从 3-LL 精确对角化结果推断出的趋势具有竞争力。这些结果表明，可以在不牺牲神经网络波函数灵活性的情况下适当地合并物理先验，从而为具有 LL 混合的 FQH 系统的精确、可扩展建模开辟了一条有希望的道路。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验和灵活性》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
full_list.title_zh: MOFFieldBench：金属有机框架中连续电子场的机器学习基准
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.
full_list.abstract_zh: 金属有机框架（MOF）的机器学习模型主要依赖于原子结构，而电子密度（ED）和静电势（ESP）场作为可扩展的学习表示仍然没有得到充分探索。这些连续场编码与结构-性质关系相关的互补空间和电子信息，特别是孔隙几何形状和客体-框架相互作用，但昂贵的第一原理计算、存储要求和系统对齐数据集的稀缺限制了它们的更广泛使用。在这里，我们介绍 MOFFieldBench，这是一个多模态基准，由大约 46,000 个 MOF 组成，具有一对一排列的晶体结构、ED 场和 ESP 场。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 金属有机框架（MOF）的机器学习模型主要依赖于原子结构，而电子密度（ED）和静电势（ESP）场作为可扩展的学习表示仍然没有得到充分探索。这些连续场编码与结构-性质关系相关的互补空间和电子信息，特别是孔隙几何形状和客体-框架相互作用，但昂贵的第一原理计算、存储要求和系统对齐数据集的稀缺限制了它们的更广泛使用。在这里，我们介绍 MOFFieldBench，这是一个多模态基准，由大约 46,000 个 MOF 组成，具有一对一排列的晶体结构、ED 场和 ESP 场。统一的工作流程集成了场生成、误差控制压缩和稀疏点云表示，支持场重建、13 种材料属性预测、多模态属性预测和成对跨模态检索。 ED 和 ESP 为孔隙几何形状、吸附和分离特性提供了有竞争力的表征。多模态融合相对于最佳单模态参考改进了多项预测任务，支持原子结构和电子领域的互补预测作用。学习的 ED 重建非常接近第一原理参考密度，而预测密度初始化在配对测试中将自洽场计算时间平均减少了 13.59%。这些结果支持电子场作为实用、信息丰富的学习方式，并将 MOFFieldBench 建立为研究表示选择、多模态学习和电子场驱动的 MOF 建模的资源。

full_list.title_en: Ammonia-Hydrogen Phase Equilibria in Planetary Envelopes from First-Principles-Based Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的机器学习分子动力学研究行星包层中的氨-氢相平衡
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27136v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ammonia and hydrogen are major constituents of planets within and beyond the solar system, yet how they interact in planetary envelopes is poorly known. We perform large-scale two-phase coexistence simulations of the ammonia-hydrogen system from 500 to 4000 K and 0.1 to 100 GPa, driven by machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory calculations. From these we map the compositions of coexisting hydrogen-rich and ammonia-rich phases, and the critical curve that separates conditions of complete miscibility from those of phase separation. The critical temperature increases with pressure, from 500 K at 0.1 GPa to 2000 K near 30 GPa, and we find no phase separation at 3000 and 4000 K up to 100 GPa. The slope of the critical curve decreases substantially between 0.3 and 30 GPa, and the curve nearly flattens above about 30 GPa and 2000 K, where molecules begin to give way to atomic species. The coexistence curves are asymmetric with an ammonia-rich critical composition. For the expected envelope compositions, the phase boundary lies close to, and intersects, published thermal profiles of Uranus and Neptune, implying ammonia may be raining out in these planets today. In contrast, in warm sub-Neptunes such as TOI-270 d, ammonia and hydrogen are likely miscible in all proportions. Together with previous studies, our results suggest that silicates, water and ammonia separate from hydrogen in sequence as planets cool, with implications for their compositional, thermal and structural evolution.
full_list.abstract_zh: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。临界温度随着压力的增加而增加，从 0.1 GPa 时的 500 K 到接近 30 GPa 的 2000 K，并且我们发现在 3000 和 4000 K 直至 100 GPa 时没有相分离。临界曲线的斜率在 0.3 至 30 GPa 之间大幅下降，并且在约 30 GPa 和 2000 K 以上，曲线几乎变平，此时分子开始让位于原子物种。共存曲线与富含氨的临界成分不对称。对于预期的包络成分，相界位于天王星和海王星已发表的热剖面附近并与之相交，这意味着今天这些行星上可能会下雨。相比之下，在TOI-270 d等温暖的亚海王星中，氨和氢可能以任何比例混溶。结合之前的研究，我们的结果表明，当行星冷却时，硅酸盐、水和氨会依次与氢分离，这对其成分、热和结构演化产生影响。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-Guided Machine Learning of Spin-Dependent Nonlinear Hall Response
full_list.title_zh: 自旋相关非线性霍尔响应的对称引导机器学习
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Berry-curvature dipole can produce a nonlinear Hall current even when the linear Hall response vanishes, but symmetry alone does not determine its magnitude or magnetic tunability. The interplay of structural symmetry, moment orientation, and carrier occupation is examined in a honeycomb model. Curvature maps and the band-summed dipole integrand reveal how velocity and the occupation window near the Fermi level select signed contributions. Removing threefold rotation permits a nonmagnetic dipole perpendicular to the surviving mirror. Generic magnetic reorientation activates the second component and tunes both components through positive and negative values. Global reversal preserves the dipole while reversing the intrinsic linear Hall conductivity, allowing a finite bulk dipole contribution from equally populated reversed domains under uniform-field averaging.A symmetry-constrained polynomial model predicts both dipole components for 256 held-out spin configurations, achieving coefficients of determination R² > 0.9995 at the reference chemical potential. At fixed carrier density, orientation-dependent shifts of the chemical potential modify the response and yield slightly larger prediction errors for the chosen model. Across the chemical-potential sweep,the prediction accuracy decreases more strongly for D_y,revealing an energy dependence of the surrogate's performance. Within semiclassical transport with a constant relaxation time, the calculated dipole determines the angular dependence of the quadratic current and its rectified and second-harmonic components. These results provide a quantitative representation of magnetic-orientation-dependent Berry-curvature dipoles and show how carrier occupation influences both the response and its predictability.
full_list.abstract_zh: 即使线性霍尔响应消失，贝里曲率偶极子也可以产生非线性霍尔电流，但仅对称性并不能决定其大小或磁可调谐性。在蜂窝模型中检查结构对称性、力矩方向和载流子占据的相互作用。曲率图和能带求和偶极子被积函数揭示了费米能级附近的速度和占据窗口如何选择符号贡献。消除三重旋转允许非磁性偶极子垂直于幸存的镜子。通用磁重定向激活第二个组件并通过正值和负值调整两个组件。全局反转保留了偶极子，同时反转了固有的线性霍尔电导率，从而允许在均匀场平均下来自同等数量的反转域的有限体偶极子贡献。

full_list.title_en: Interpretable Machine Learning Reveals Atom-Resolved VOCs Adsorption and Reactivity on Metal Oxides
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interpretable Machine Learning Reveals Atom-Resolved VOCs Adsorption and Reactivity on Metal Oxides
full_list.abstract: The adsorption and reactivity of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) on metal oxides govern catalytic reaction pathways, yet predictive rules remain elusive because molecular functionality, surface chemistry, and adsorption geometry are strongly coupled. Here we report a transferable adsorption dual-tower framework (AdsDT) that independently encodes molecular and crystal features to predict adsorption energies directly from unrelaxed CIF structures. By pretraining on the Open Catalyst 2020 dataset and progressively transferring through intermediate adsorption systems, AdsDT enables rapid construction of metal oxides-VOCs interaction databases and achieves strong agreement with density functional theory calculations (R2 = 0.85). Using 816 TiO2 (anatase, 101)-VOCs adsorption configurations, we combine molecular fingerprints, SHAP analysis, and graph attention mapping to identify fragment-level and atom-resolved adsorption contribution. Saturated alkyl carbon environments increase predicted adsorption energies, whereas unsaturated and electronegative atoms, particularly carbonyl oxygen, favor stronger adsorption. Extension to eight representative metal oxides reveals material-dependent and functional-group correlation. Furthermore, a bond activation score integrating atomic attention, bond dissociation energy, and bond polarization links adsorption configurations to reaction pathways, showing that adsorption sites activate neighboring bonds through electronic redistribution rather than serving simply as cleavage centers. These results provide transferable atom-resolved descriptors for VOCs adsorption and catalytic reactivity across metal oxides.

full_list.title_en: SimuScan-Agent: language-model orchestration of synthetic-data-driven autonomous atomic force microscopy
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：SimuScan-Agent: language-model orchestration of synthetic-data-driven autonomous atomic force microscopy
full_list.abstract: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) enables nanoscale characterization, but large-area investigations remain slow and require coordination of data preparation, model training and instrument operation. Here we introduce SimuScan-Agent, an LLM-orchestrated framework that translates natural-language objectives into adaptive AFM workflows. Combining multimodal morphological sources with physics-informed simulation, it generates annotated synthetic datasets without manual per-image labeling, trains and deploys segmentation and representation-learning models, and guides acquisition using online detections and class-specific sampling objectives. In simulations, probabilistic active exploration reduced measurements and sampled area by approximately 71% relative to raster scanning. Experimentally, SimuScan-Agent explored a ~10 mm² region by sampling 17.2% of available positions, estimating class-specific spatial distributions and assembling a morphological library to identify representative and atypical nanostructures. By linking synthetic-data generation, machine learning and adaptive acquisition through natural-language interaction, the framework lowers barriers to goal-directed nanoscale studies and offers a foundation for more intelligent, autonomous AFM systems that adapt experimental decisions to what they learn during measurement.

full_list.title_en: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
full_list.title_zh: GBClaw：用于原子晶界研究和机制发现的代理人工智能框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applied to 14 general asymmetric tilt GBs in nickel, GBClaw characterized interfacial defect structures and identified diverse deformation modes across these incommensurate boundaries. Comparing boundary sliding with and without secondary GB misfit dislocations revealed substantial differences in shear strength, underscoring the critical role of defect hierarchies in sliding resistance. Furthermore, researcher-guided follow-up calculations traced an anomalously high shear resistance to metastable boundary structures. This work demonstrates that combining agentic AI with domain expertise bridges high-throughput computational screening with deep physical understanding of complex material interfaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: 代理人工智能（AI）系统在材料发现和设计中复杂工作流程自动化方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域密集型机械研究仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 GBClaw，一种用于研究一般晶界 (GB) 结构和变形的代理人工智能框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中绝大多数现实世界的界面，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验和建模研究变得复杂，因此它们仍然未被充分研究。 GBClaw 将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到模块化架构中，其中包括协调器、专用代理、特定领域工具、模拟接口和分层内存。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 代理人工智能（AI）系统在材料发现和设计中复杂工作流程自动化方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域密集型机械研究仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 GBClaw，一种用于研究一般晶界 (GB) 结构和变形的代理人工智能框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中绝大多数现实世界的界面，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验和建模研究变得复杂，因此它们仍然未被充分研究。 GBClaw 将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到模块化架构中，其中包括协调器、专用代理、特定领域工具、模拟接口和分层内存。通过动态重新规划和迭代工作流程细化，该框架有效地将系统模拟与有针对性的机制分析联系起来。 GBClaw 应用于镍中的 14 个一般不对称倾斜晶界，描述了界面缺陷结构，并识别了这些不相称边界上的不同变形模式。比较有和没有二次晶界错配位错的边界滑动揭示了剪切强度的显着差异，强调了缺陷层次在滑动阻力中的关键作用。此外，研究人员引导的后续计算发现亚稳态边界结构具有异常高的抗剪力。这项工作表明，将代理人工智能与领域专业知识相结合，可以将高通量计算筛选与对复杂材料界面的深入物理理解联系起来。
full_list.summary: 代理人工智能（AI）系统在材料发现和设计中复杂工作流程自动化方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域密集型机械研究仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 GBClaw，一种用于研究一般晶界 (GB) 结构和变形的代理人工智能框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中绝大多数现实世界的界面，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验和建模研究变得复杂，因此它们仍然未被充分研究。 GBClaw 将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到模块化架构中，其中包括协调器、专用代理、特定领域工具、模拟接口和分层内存。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《GBClaw：用于原子晶界研究和机制发现的代理人工智能框架》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Strain-Dependent Wetting of Graphene
full_list.title_zh: 石墨烯的应变相关润湿
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.20134v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding how water wets graphene is critical for predicting and controlling its behaviour in nanofluidic, sensing, and energy applications. A key measure of wetting is the contact angle made by a liquid droplet against the surface, yet experimental measurements for graphene span a wide range, with no consensus for free-standing graphene. Here, we use a machine learning potential with ab initio accuracy to provide an atomistic first-principles prediction for this unsolved problem, finding a weakly hydrophilic contact angle of 72.1 ± 1.5 deg. More importantly, we unveil that graphene's wetting properties are highly sensitive to mechanical strain: tensile strain makes graphene significantly less hydrophilic, while compressive strain induces coherent ripples around the droplet, resulting in pronounced anisotropic wetting and contact angle hysteresis. We show that there is a strong coupling between the three-phase contact line and the intrinsic thermal ripples of free-standing graphene, which contributes to this strain sensitivity. Our results demonstrate that the wettability of 2D membranes are governed not only by their chemistry but also by their dynamic morphology, introducing a new class of wetting behaviour unique to atomically thin materials that offers an additional explanation for variability in experimental measurements. These findings reveal that mechanical strain may be a practical route to controlling wetting in 2D nanomaterials-based technologies, with promising consequences for nanofluidic and nano-filtration applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 了解水如何润湿石墨烯对于预测和控制其在纳米流体、传感和能源应用中的行为至关重要。润湿的一个关键指标是液滴与表面形成的接触角，但石墨烯的实验测量范围很广，对于独立式石墨烯尚未达成共识。在这里，我们使用从头算精度的机器学习潜力，为这个未解决的问题提供原子第一原理预测，发现弱亲水接触角为 72.1 ± 1.5 度。更重要的是，我们发现石墨烯的润湿特性对机械应变高度敏感：拉伸应变使石墨烯的亲水性显着降低，而压缩应变会在液滴周围引起相干波纹，从而导致明显的各向异性润湿和接触角滞后。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 了解水如何润湿石墨烯对于预测和控制其在纳米流体、传感和能源应用中的行为至关重要。润湿的一个关键指标是液滴与表面形成的接触角，但石墨烯的实验测量范围很广，对于独立式石墨烯尚未达成共识。在这里，我们使用从头算精度的机器学习潜力，为这个未解决的问题提供原子第一原理预测，发现弱亲水接触角为 72.1 ± 1.5 度。更重要的是，我们发现石墨烯的润湿特性对机械应变高度敏感：拉伸应变使石墨烯的亲水性显着降低，而压缩应变会在液滴周围引起相干波纹，从而导致明显的各向异性润湿和接触角滞后。我们表明，三相接触线和独立石墨烯的固有热波纹之间存在很强的耦合，这导致了这种应变敏感性。我们的结果表明，二维膜的润湿性不仅受其化学性质的影响，还受其动态形态的影响，引入了原子薄材料特有的一类新的润湿行为，为实验测量的可变性提供了额外的解释。这些发现表明，机械应变可能是控制基于二维纳米材料的技术中润湿的实用途径，对纳米流体和纳米过滤应用具有良好的效果。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：机器学习势与原子级动力学、第一性原理标注与结构优化。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《石墨烯的应变相关润湿》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Acceleration of CTQMC via Denoising Diffusion Models with Auxiliary Spectral Functions
full_list.title_zh: 通过具有辅助谱函数的去噪扩散模型加速 CTQMC
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-time Quantum Monte Carlo (CTQMC) impurity solvers are a numerically exact, but expensive, option for solving the Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) equations, with statistical noise from undersampling presenting a major challenge to low temperature studies. This noise is especially egregious within the sampled self-energy, which can destabilize the self-consistency loop upon insertion into the Dyson equation. In this work, we introduce a neural denoiser for fermionic imaginary time Green's functions based on the diffusion model architecture trained on synthetic data. The network predicts positive and normalized auxiliary spectral functions consistent with the noisy imaginary axis CTQMC data, which is then refined via autodifferentiation to match the measured self-energy, its first two high-frequency moments, and impurity occupation similar to the Constrained Residual Minimization (CRM) method. This leads to Green's functions and self-energies that are causal by design. Through this denoising framework we are able to reduce the required CTQMC measurement steps by a factor of 10-100. We benchmark our method with a half-filled Hubbard model on a Bethe lattice, a two-patch Dynamical Cluster Approximation (DCA) of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, and the SrVO₃ system. We reproduce the Mott transition upon increasing Coulomb interaction for the half-filled Hubbard model with only 5000 CTQMC measurements, the pseudogap transition for the DCA two-dimensional Hubbard model with only 5×10⁵ measurements, and match the spectral function of SrVO₃ with 50 times fewer measurements than the reference. Since we generate auxiliary spectral functions, we recover the approximate spectral functions of the systems for free without performing analytic continuation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 连续时间量子蒙特卡罗 (CTQMC) 杂质求解器是求解动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 方程的数值精确但昂贵的选择，欠采样产生的统计噪声给低温研究带来了重大挑战。这种噪声在采样的自能中尤其严重，在插入戴森方程时可能会破坏自洽环的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们基于在合成数据上训练的扩散模型架构，引入了费米子虚数时间格林函数的神经降噪器。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 连续时间量子蒙特卡罗 (CTQMC) 杂质求解器是求解动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 方程的数值精确但昂贵的选择，欠采样产生的统计噪声给低温研究带来了重大挑战。这种噪声在采样的自能中尤其严重，在插入戴森方程时可能会破坏自洽环的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们基于在合成数据上训练的扩散模型架构，引入了费米子虚数时间格林函数的神经降噪器。该网络预测与噪声虚轴 CTQMC 数据一致的正和归一化辅助谱函数，然后通过自微分进行细化，以匹配测量的自能、前两个高频矩以及类似于约束残差最小化 (CRM) 方法的杂质占据。这导致了格林函数和自能是设计上的因果关系。通过这个去噪框架，我们能够将所需的 CTQMC 测量步骤减少 10-100 倍。我们使用 Bethe 晶格上的半填充 Hubbard 模型、二维 Hubbard 模型的两面片动态聚类逼近 (DCA) 以及 SrVO₃ 系统对我们的方法进行基准测试。我们通过仅 5000 个 CTQMC 测量的半填充 Hubbard 模型再现了增加库仑相互作用的莫特跃迁，仅用 5×10⁵ 测量的 DCA 二维 Hubbard 模型的赝能隙跃迁，并以比参考少 50 倍的测量来匹配 SrVO₃ 的谱函数。由于我们生成辅助谱函数，因此我们可以免费恢复系统的近似谱函数，而无需执行解析延拓。

full_list.title_en: Effective Atom Theory: Gradient-Driven Materials Design
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Effective Atom Theory: Gradient-Driven Materials Design
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2509.07180v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Effective Atom Theory (EAT), which embeds discrete atomic identities into a continuous differentiable space. During optimization, sites pass through temporary effective mixtures, then are driven to fully discrete, physically realizable atoms. This enables gradient-based optimization in DFT and MLIPs, yielding orders-of-magnitude acceleration over discrete methods. EAT recovers the exact ground state of NaCl in a 128 atom cell, reconstructs the Cu-Pd phase diagram, optimizes high-entropy oxides for oxygen evolution, and discovers bonding topologies as demonstrated for SrTiO3.

full_list.title_en: INCARBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Configuration in VASP INCAR by Large Language Models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：INCARBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Configuration in VASP INCAR by Large Language Models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.23571v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into first-principles computational workflows, yet their ability to configure scientific calculations remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce INCARBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on input configuration for the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) through both configuration generation and repair tasks. Evaluating 19 model configurations reveals substantial capability differences among current frontier models. While several models achieve high semantic and policy accuracy, task-critical correctness remains substantially lower, demonstrating that parameter-level correctness does not necessarily imply scientifically valid configurations. Failure analysis shows that errors concentrate in physically coupled settings involving DFT+U, magnetism, and correlated materials, where multiple constraints must be satisfied simultaneously. Repair evaluation further reveals that correcting incorrect settings and preserving already-valid configurations are distinct capabilities, with configuration preservation remaining a major challenge. These findings establish scientific configuration as a measurable capability of large language models and provide a foundation for developing more reliable AI systems for computational materials science.

full_list.title_en: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
full_list.title_zh: 使用训练有素的神经正切核学习材料空间的几何形状
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in T_c. These results establish trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations, connecting property prediction with the exploration of materials space.
full_list.abstract_zh: 经过训练来预测材料属性的神经网络学习其物理内容可能难以提取的表示。我们使用神经正切核（NTK），在训练参数下进行评估，来恢复网络学习到的几何形状，该网络仅根据元素组成来预测超导转变温度。使用经过训练的 NTK 进行的核岭回归可以很好地再现网络的预测性能，并且大大优于使用初始核进行的回归。谱分析和多维尺度揭示了由少数方向主导的几何形状。聚类和局部邻域分析将化合物组织成可识别的超导族，并将材料与相关化学和相关电子特性联系起来，尽管 T_c 存在显着差异。

full_list.title_en: CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep generative modeling has achieved remarkable progress in crystal generation. Given the rich symmetries inherent in crystalline structures, recent work has sought to explicitly incorporate space-group symmetry into generative models, enabling more effective exploration of novel symmetry templates. Yet introducing symmetry templates increases the combinatorial complexity of stoichiometric relationships between atomic species and crystallographic sites, while creating a fundamental tension between flexible exploration of discrete crystallographic templates and faithful realization of these templates as continuous three-dimensional structures. To address these challenges, we propose CrystalAR, a unified autoregressive framework that models Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures within a single generative sequence. Specifically, CrystalAR reformulates continuous coordinate generation as a symmetry-conditioned hierarchy of discrete spatial localization decisions, autoregressively refining the positions of all symmetry-inequivalent sites across resolution levels while jointly modeling their spatial configuration within each level. This discrete hierarchical formulation further enables constraint-aware search over both crystallographic templates and geometric realizations. As a result, CrystalAR retains strong symmetry-template generation capability while achieving competitive de novo generation performance and template-free crystal structure prediction (CSP) accuracy. These results suggest that symmetry-template generation can be retained alongside broadly competitive de novo generation performance and competitive CSP without reliance on symmetry templates retrieved from prior data, providing a promising alternative paradigm for symmetry-preserving crystal generation.

full_list.title_en: TexFlow: learning crystallographic texture on SO(3) manifold via normalizing flows
full_list.title_zh: TexFlow：通过归一化流学习 SO(3) 流形上的晶体纹理
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystallographic texture is an important microstructural feature that statistically describes the orientations of grains in polycrystalline materials. Conventional texture analysis relies on the orientation distribution functions and pole figures, which are essential for interpreting the texture of a given material specimen but do not, by themselves, provide a direct framework for predictive modeling of process-structure-property linkages. Data- and machine learning-based approaches offer a means to address this gap; however, a key challenge lies in developing representations and learning frameworks that account for the manifold structure of rotations. In particular, many existing machine learning techniques are designed for Euclidean data and therefore are not readily applicable to rotations in the non-Euclidean group SO(3). Here we introduce TexFlow, a conditional normalizing flow framework for texture modeling that learns a probability distribution over rotations in SO(3) by construction. Rotations are encoded in a six-dimensional Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization representation which is then mapped back to valid rotations RinSO(3). The framework supports conditional probabilistic modeling of texture p(R|c), where c may represent processing parameters like temperature or deformation state. To complement conventional texture-analysis visualizations, such as pole figures and sections of the orientation distribution function, we further introduce Hopf-fibration visualizations as a compact global representation of texture. TexFlow is validated on both unconditional and conditional experimental and simulated texture datasets spanning diverse material systems. We show that TexFlow can accurately capture multimodal textures and their conditional evolution, providing a data-driven framework for establishing process-texture linkages.
full_list.abstract_zh: 晶体织构是一种重要的微观结构特征，它统计地描述了多晶材料中晶粒的取向。传统的纹理分析依赖于方向分布函数和极图，这对于解释给定材料样本的纹理至关重要，但它们本身并不能为过程-结构-性能联系的预测建模提供直接的框架。基于数据和机器学习的方法提供了解决这一差距的方法；然而，一个关键的挑战在于开发能够解释轮换的多种结构的表示和学习框架。特别是，许多现有的机器学习技术是针对欧几里德数据设计的，因此不容易应用于非欧几里德群 SO(3) 中的旋转。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 晶体织构是一种重要的微观结构特征，它统计地描述了多晶材料中晶粒的取向。传统的纹理分析依赖于方向分布函数和极图，这对于解释给定材料样本的纹理至关重要，但它们本身并不能为过程-结构-性能联系的预测建模提供直接的框架。基于数据和机器学习的方法提供了解决这一差距的方法；然而，一个关键的挑战在于开发能够解释轮换的多种结构的表示和学习框架。特别是，许多现有的机器学习技术是针对欧几里德数据设计的，因此不容易应用于非欧几里德群 SO(3) 中的旋转。在这里，我们介绍 TexFlow，一种用于纹理建模的条件归一化流框架，它通过构造学习 SO(3) 中旋转的概率分布。旋转以六维 Gram-Schmidt 正交化表示进行编码，然后映射回有效旋转 RinSO(3)。该框架支持纹理 p(R|c) 的条件概率建模，其中 c 可以表示温度或变形状态等处理参数。为了补充传统的纹理分析可视化，例如极图和方向分布函数的截面，我们进一步引入 Hopf 纤维化可视化作为纹理的紧凑全局表示。 TexFlow 在跨越不同材料系统的无条件和条件实验和模拟纹理数据集上进行了验证。我们证明，TexFlow 可以准确捕获多模态纹理及其条件演化，为建立过程-纹理链接提供数据驱动的框架。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《TexFlow：通过归一化流学习 SO(3) 流形上的晶体纹理》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
full_list.title_zh: LatticeMind：密度泛函理论工作流程的验证门代理框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh₆/InₓGa₁₋ₓN photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.
full_list.abstract_zh: 第一原理计算很少是单个求解器调用：它们是多阶段工作流程，其中结构、设置和保存的密度必须在相关阶段之间正确传递。语言模型可以编写有效的单个输入，但一旦阶段链接起来，可靠性就会崩溃：即使在求解器运行时，丢失的依赖项、错误的文件切换或幻觉的关键字也可能使结果无效，并且此类错误只有在昂贵的执行后才会出现。我们引入了 LatticeMind，这是一个验证门控代理框架，可将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 项目。工作流合同指定所需的阶段、文件和依赖项；
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 第一原理计算很少是单个求解器调用：它们是多阶段工作流程，其中结构、设置和保存的密度必须在相关阶段之间正确传递。语言模型可以编写有效的单个输入，但一旦阶段链接起来，可靠性就会崩溃：即使在求解器运行时，丢失的依赖项、错误的文件切换或幻觉的关键字也可能使结果无效，并且此类错误只有在昂贵的执行后才会出现。我们引入了 LatticeMind，这是一个验证门控代理框架，可将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 项目。工作流合同指定所需的阶段、文件和依赖项；确定性验证器在启动任何求解器之前检查项目；失败的检查触发有限修复；报告仍然可以追溯到项目文件。在涵盖总能量、态密度、能带结构、磁性、声子工作流程的 44 例 RESCU 基准测试中，三个非旗舰 LLM 后端再现了每个参考值； 132 次运行中的 119 次通过了第一个验证计划，其余的则在一个修复周期后通过。 Ablations 将工作流契约和执行前验证确定为主要的可靠性机制；传统的试验和修复基线达到 71%，每次成功的代币成本是两倍。相同的架构重现了 19 个案例 VASP 基准上的每个参考值，展示了跨求解器的传输。除了这些任务系列之外，LatticeMind 还生成并验证了 Rh₆/InₓGa₁₋ₓN 光催化剂界面处 Rh 诱导电子响应的多阶段研究的 23 个输入。这些结果建立了工作流契约、确定性验证、有界修复和可追溯记录，作为可靠的人工智能辅助科学计算的实践基础，在执行之前捕获可预防的错误，并且求解器永远不是第一个验证器。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 密度泛函理论和电子结构计算，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《LatticeMind：密度泛函理论工作流程的验证门代理框架》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Probabilistic denoising for reliable signal extraction in spectroscopy
full_list.title_zh: 用于光谱学中可靠信号提取的概率去噪
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.07819v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While deep learning offers powerful capabilities for scientific research, its application is often hindered by a lack of quantitative reliability. To address this, we introduce a probabilistic denoising framework that simultaneously extracts denoised signals and element-wise predictive uncertainties from noisy data. We demonstrate this approach on three-dimensional angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy data, showing that the model reliably recovers the spectral features of a cuprate superconductor from Poisson-distributed noise with an average count of only 0.02 electrons per voxel. Crucially, we show that these predicted uncertainties can be propagated into subsequent superconducting gap analyses, enabling quantitative parameter extraction with scientifically meaningful error bars. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our approach by successfully extending it to two-dimensional X-ray diffraction data. Ultimately, this approach establishes uncertainty-aware deep learning not merely as a visualization tool, but as a rigorous framework for scientific data analysis.
full_list.abstract_zh: 虽然深度学习为科学研究提供了强大的能力，但其应用往往因缺乏定量可靠性而受到阻碍。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个概率去噪框架，该框架同时从噪声数据中提取去噪信号和元素预测不确定性。我们在三维角度分辨光发射光谱数据上演示了这种方法，表明该模型可靠地从泊松分布的噪声中恢复了铜酸盐超导体的光谱特征，平均每个体素只有0.02个电子。至关重要的是，我们表明这些预测的不确定性可以传播到随后的超导间隙分析中，从而使用具有科学意义的误差条进行定量参数提取。

full_list.title_en: E8-QAT: Efficient 2-Bit Quantization-Aware Training with Implicit Lattice Codebooks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：E8-QAT: Efficient 2-Bit Quantization-Aware Training with Implicit Lattice Codebooks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint of large language models, but preserving accuracy with efficient training remains challenging. Scalar quantization encodes weights independently, while explicit-codebook vector quantization introduces costly search during training. We propose E8-QAT, a 2-bit quantization-aware training framework that uses the E₈ lattice as an implicit eight-dimensional codebook. It jointly quantizes weight groups through arithmetic projection without storing or searching an explicit codebook during the training forward pass. A 2-bit core encoding and sparse extension preserve the selected lattice points exactly, adding less than 0.1% to core index storage. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, E8-QAT matches the performance of the full-precision model in terms of the average score across the four tasks. E8-QAT improves over the state-of-the-art baseline by 2.03% on IFEval and by 1.51% on LiveCodeBench, under the same data, schedule, and bit width. The 2-bit representation reduces peak memory by 80% and supports a 4× larger batch. At each representation's largest feasible batch, E8-QAT reaches 1.97× the decoding throughput of BF16.

full_list.title_en: Exact 1D Nonlinear Solutions for Proton-Driven Plasma Wakefields
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Exact 1D Nonlinear Solutions for Proton-Driven Plasma Wakefields
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.06458v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We extend the classical 1D nonlinear relativistic plasma wakefield paradigm to evaluate the pristine fluid profiles driven by intense relativistic proton trains under the comoving coordinate approximation. Using an intense two-bunch scheme, our adaptive integration model is validated down to machine precision against exact closed-form cold-fluid invariants, confirming that interface boundary corners represent physical step discontinuities in the second potential derivative. Scaling to an N=100 micro-bunch train, we resolve macroscopic phase-accumulation and subsequent nonlinear detuning by deriving a closed-form, parameter-free piecewise analytical envelope expression. This solution successfully maps the initial unattenuated quadratic coherent growth alongside the flat asymptotic horizontal saturation horizon governed by nonlinear energy conservation. Furthermore, the framework analytically evaluates the transient envelope overshoot, tracking its decay onto the saturation boundary via an exact phase-slip integration length scale. Providing immediate, ready macro-envelope bounds, this computationally inexpensive tool eliminates empirical adjustments and yields a robust mathematical baseline designed to guide and accelerate complex, multi-dimensional particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations through rapid parameter space exploration before deploying heavy computational assets. It establishes an efficient foundation to optimize asymmetric, custom-shaped driver profiles required to break the fundamental symmetric transformer ratio limit of 2 to make current particle accelerators more efficient.

full_list.title_en: Dramatic pressure-induced slowdown and the soft glassy rheology of water at 2D material interface
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dramatic pressure-induced slowdown and the soft glassy rheology of water at 2D material interface
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The flow of molecularly confined water has attracted considerable interest in recent years. Yet despite their exquisite character, current nanofluidic devices cannot probe molecular water flow beyond the linear-response regime, while nanomechanical force- based approaches have produced markedly inconsistent results. Here, using tuning- fork-based atomic force microscopy, we tackle these limitations by measuring the full linear-to-nonlinear, shear-dependent viscoelastic rheology of molecularly confined water at various two-dimensional material interfaces -- demonstrating pronounced rate effects in water flow response. The observed rheological behaviors are remarkably analogous to that of macroscopic soft glassy yielding materials and fully captured by a non-linear model accounting for the shear-induced acceleration of the dynamics -- a hallmark of disordered supercooled and metastable systems. We further unveil a pronounced pressure-induced slowdown in nanoconfined water dynamics, with relaxation times extending into the microsecond range and marked material dependence. These results reveal non-linear, glassy rheology as a general feature of interfacial water and offer a route to tunable, non-linear nanofluidic elements.

full_list.title_en: Generalized Spin Groups and Applications to Magnons
full_list.title_zh: 广义自旋群及其在磁振子中的应用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin groups provide the natural symmetry framework for the isotropic Heisenberg model, in which spin and lattice degrees of freedom are separable. They have recently found broad applications in describing electronic band structure, magnon band topology, and transport phenomena. However, a typical spin Hamiltonian describing magnons contains not only isotropic Heisenberg exchange but also anisotropic interactions induced by spin-orbit coupling (SOC), including the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, the Gamma exchange, and the single-ion anisotropy (SIA), which strongly influence magnon properties. More recently, some studies have also revealed relativistic magnon transport phenomena in altermagnets. Such systems typically exhibit partial spin-lattice locking, but are commonly assumed to be described by conventional magnetic groups. Here, we develop a systematic symmetry framework, generalized spin groups, for magnons. We first classify the symmetries of Heisenberg, DM, Gamma, and SIA interactions. The resulting classification contains 6 spin-only groups, together with a total of 161 nontrivial spin groups. The symmetries of magnetically ordered phases are then obtained through spontaneous symmetry breaking of the corresponding parent groups for spin Hamiltonians. We also identify 6 spin-only groups for ordered states, which generate 90, 264, 157, 264, 387, and 598 nontrivial spin groups, respectively. Finally, we apply generalized spin groups to the magnon thermal conductivity and spin conductivity tensors and derive all the symmetry-allowed forms. Our results provide a unified symmetry framework for analyzing magnon transport both with and without SOC, yielding more refined constraints on magnon responses.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。此类系统通常表现出部分自旋晶格锁定，但通常假设由常规磁性基团描述。在这里，我们为磁振子开发了一个系统的对称框架，即广义自旋群。我们首先对 Heisenberg、DM、Gamma 和 SIA 相互作用的对称性进行分类。生成的分类包含 6 个仅自旋组，以及总共 161 个非平凡自旋组。然后通过自旋哈密顿量的相应母群的自发对称破缺获得磁有序相的对称性。我们还确定了有序态的 6 个仅自旋群，它们分别生成 90、264、157、264、387 和 598 个非平凡自旋群。最后，我们将广义自旋群应用于磁振子热导率和自旋电导率张量，并导出所有对称允许的形式。我们的结果提供了一个统一的对称框架，用于分析有和没有 SOC 的磁振子输运，从而对磁振子响应产生更精细的约束。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《广义自旋群及其在磁振子中的应用》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Graph-Theoretic Analysis of Phase Optimization Complexity in Variational Wave Functions for Heisenberg Antiferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 海森堡反铁磁体变分波函数相位优化复杂度的图论分析
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.04943v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the computational complexity of learning the ground state phase structure of Heisenberg antiferromagnets. Representing Hilbert space as a weighted graph, the variational energy defines a weighted XY model that, for Z₂ phases, reduces to a classical antiferromagnetic Ising model on that graph. For fixed amplitudes, reconstructing the signs of the ground state wavefunction thus reduces to a weighted Max-Cut instance. This links sign optimization of wavefunctions directly to combinatorial optimization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了学习海森堡反铁磁体基态相结构的计算复杂性。将希尔伯特空间表示为加权图，变分能量定义了加权 XY 模型，对于 Z2 相，该模型简化为该图上的经典反铁磁 Ising 模型。对于固定振幅，重建基态波函数的符号因此减少为加权最大割实例。这将波函数的符号优化直接与组合优化联系起来。

full_list.title_en: Lattice symmetry breaking and strain control of single-q magnetism in Na₃Co₂SbO₆
full_list.title_zh: Na₃Co2SbO₆中单q磁性的晶格对称性破缺与应变控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distinguishing single-q from multi-q magnetism constrains microscopic spin Hamiltonians. Here we determine the ground state of the candidate Kitaev magnet Na₃Co₂SbO₆ through its coupling to the lattice. High-resolution neutron diffraction reveals a spontaneous monoclinic-to-triclinic distortion at the magnetic transition, in contrast to the absence of detectable lattice-symmetry breaking in triple-q Na₂Co₂TeO₆. Together with strain-selective magnetic responses, this identifies single-q order in Na₃Co₂SbO₆ over the proposed symmetry-preserving double-q state. Uniaxial compression along a low-symmetry in-plane direction achieves the domain selection that magnetic-field training could not, revealing the intrinsic field-induced phase boundaries of the dominant domain. These results establish strain as a symmetry-conjugate field for magnetic domains and highlight magnetoelastic coupling as a route to diagnose, manipulate, and potentially tune magnetic states.
full_list.abstract_zh: 区分单 q 与多 q 磁性限制了微观自旋哈密顿量。在这里，我们通过与晶格的耦合确定了候选基塔耶夫磁体 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 的基态。高分辨率中子衍射揭示了磁转变时自发的单斜晶向三斜晶畸变，与三q Na2Co2TeO6 中不存在可检测到的晶格对称性破缺相反。与应变选择性磁响应一起，这确定了 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 中所提出的对称性保持双 q 态的单 q 级。沿低对称性面内方向的单轴压缩实现了磁场训练无法实现的域选择，揭示了主域的固有场感应相边界。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Fisher Information in semiclassical magnon systems
full_list.title_zh: 半经典磁子系统中的量子费希尔信息
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.20424v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) is a powerful spectroscopic tool to witness many-body quantum entanglement in solid state materials, but it is not always obvious how to relate it to other characteristics of condensed matter systems. In this study we elaborate on the meaning and interpretation of QFI in condensed matter by examining simple theoretical spin systems. We use finite sized spin systems to illustrate that QFI quantifies the momentum- dependent degree of quantum entanglement (that is the entanglement depth at a given wave vector) within a wave function. We subsequently use semiclassical frustrated spin models to show that, in the context of linear spin wave theory (LSWT), QFI quantifies the momentum-dependent degree of magnon squeezing in the ground state. In antiferromagnets with a zero-energy Goldstone mode, LSWT breaks down and QFI (and entanglement depth) diverges at the magnetic ordering wave vector. We also show examples of emergent quantum phases in frustrated spin systems that do not appear in classical phase diagrams. When these emergent phases are approached, QFI diverges across multiple wave vectors in momentum space. Taken together, QFI is not only helpful as a lower bound for entanglement depth, but serves as a momentum-resolved probe of entanglement that offers a novel perspective on quantum critical phenomena.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子费希尔信息（ QFI ）是一种见证固态材料中多体量子纠缠的强大光谱工具，但如何将其与凝聚态系统的其他特征联系起来并不总是很明显。在本研究中，我们通过检查简单的理论自旋系统来阐述QFI在凝聚态物质中的含义和解释。我们使用有限尺寸的自旋系统来说明QFI量化了波函数内量子纠缠的动量依赖程度（即给定波矢量处的纠缠深度）。随后，我们使用半经典挫折自旋模型来证明，在线性自旋波理论（ LSWT ）的背景下， QFI量化了基态中磁子挤压的动量依赖程度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子费希尔信息（ QFI ）是一种见证固态材料中多体量子纠缠的强大光谱工具，但如何将其与凝聚态系统的其他特征联系起来并不总是很明显。在本研究中，我们通过检查简单的理论自旋系统来阐述QFI在凝聚态物质中的含义和解释。我们使用有限尺寸的自旋系统来说明QFI量化了波函数内量子纠缠的动量依赖程度（即给定波矢量处的纠缠深度）。随后，我们使用半经典挫折自旋模型来证明，在线性自旋波理论（ LSWT ）的背景下， QFI量化了基态中磁子挤压的动量依赖程度。在具有零能量Goldstone模式的反铁磁体中， LSWT分解并且QFI （和纠缠深度）在磁有序波矢量处发散。我们还展示了经典相图中没有出现的挫折自旋系统中出现的量子相的例子。当接近这些紧急阶段时， QFI在动量空间中的多个波向量之间发散。总而言之， QFI不仅有助于作为纠缠深度的下限，而且可以作为纠缠的动量分辨探针，为量子临界现象提供新的视角。

full_list.title_en: Crucial role of magnetic dipole and anomalous field dependence in NiPS₃
full_list.title_zh: 磁偶极子和反常场依赖性在 NiPS₃ 中的关键作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NiPS₃ has attracted considerable attention, yet the origin of its intriguing magnetic behaviors remains elusive due to limited insight into its low-energy anisotropy. Here, high-field torque magnetometry measurements are performed, revealing a previously unrecognized anisotropic spin response that reflects interaction terms beyond the standard XY or XXZ models. In combination with relativistic density functional theory calculations and magnetic force response theory, an effective low-energy spin Hamiltonian is constructed, elucidating not only the observed anomalous magnetic behavior but also other recent experiments. Remarkably, the magnetic dipole interaction and the associated spin-flop transition play a crucial role in driving the deviation from two-dimensional spin alignment, providing direct insight into the underlying anisotropic energy hierarchy. The generalized Hamiltonian can serve as the important fundamental ground for future study, and our approach adopted here will hopefully be relevant to many other related material systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: NiPS₃ 引起了相当大的关注，但由于对其低能各向异性的了解有限，其有趣的磁性行为的起源仍然难以捉摸。在这里，进行高场扭矩磁力测量，揭示了以前未被识别的各向异性自旋响应，该响应反映了超出标准 XY 或 XXZ 模型的相互作用项。结合相对论密度泛函理论计算和磁力响应理论，构建了有效的低能自旋哈密顿量，不仅阐明了观察到的异常磁行为，而且阐明了其他最近的实验。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Field Theory of the Gutzwiller Projection
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Field Theory of the Gutzwiller Projection
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Gutzwiller projection produces a well-known ansatz for spin-liquid and quantum Hall ground-state wavefunctions that is amenable to numerical simulation, with the Laughlin wavefunction being the most celebrated example. A long-standing issue is the precise relation between the Gutzwiller projection and the closely related parton gauge theory. Here, we clarify this issue by providing a field-theoretic description of the Gutzwiller projection. In a path integral description, the universal physics of the projected state is described in terms of a gauge field supported on a temporal slab of vanishing width ϵ → 0 coupled to the bulk matter fields. We analytically derive the universal physics of various Gutzwiller projected states. Our construction is also applicable to discrete symmetries, and we use it to analyze various projected SPT states. Among our results, we show that the Gutzwiller projection is not a good ansatz for the long-distance properties of U(1) Dirac spin liquids, spinon Fermi surface spin liquids or composite Fermi liquids, and that the Gutzwiller projection of a quantum spin Hall state has only quasi-long range order. In contrast, in examples where the gauge field is gapped, including Laughlin states, Z₂ spin liquids and Luttinger liquids, we show that the slab gauge theory from Gutzwiller projection reproduces the correct universal physics of the full parton gauge theory. We also present a generalization of our field theory that describes G-intertwining defects, with application to self-duality defects of recent theoretical interest.

full_list.title_en: Quantum Formulation of the Spinterface Model
full_list.title_zh: 旋转面模型的量子公式
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fully quantum formulation of the spinterface model for the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, implemented within the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. The model consists of a gold atom hosting a localised magnetic moment, coupled to a chiral molecular chain with Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and contacted by two non-magnetic leads. The magnetic moment is determined self-consistently from the non-equilibrium electronic distribution, and the spin-resolved transmission is computed from the mean-field Hamiltonian. We show that the interfacial magnetic moment and the chiral Rashba term cooperate to produce large current polarisations that reproduce the key experimental signatures of CISS: high polarisation, a threshold emergence at four total sites followed by interference-modulated growth with chain length, thermal suppression, and sign reversal upon chirality inversion. The central new result of this work is a clean separation of the CISS effect into an even (achiral) and an odd (chiral) contribution to the spin current, IS_z(φ) = IS_zrm eveⁿ(φ) + IS_zrm odd(φ). We demonstrate that IS_zrm odd vanishes exactly at fixed m_z for chains of fewer than four sites and becomes non-zero for chains of four or more sites, with the smallest junction exhibiting a non-zero odd part being the four-site geometry (one gold atom plus three molecular sites). The odd part arises from reciprocity breaking in a device that is simultaneously chiral, magnetically asymmetric (moment on the gold end only), and long enough to support two or more Rashba-active bonds. This provides a direct, parameter-free test of whether an observed spin signal is genuinely chiral or arises from an achiral spin-valve mechanism.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应的自旋界面模型的完全量子公式，该模型在非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式中实现。该模型由具有局域磁矩的金原子组成，通过 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合与手性分子链耦合，并通过两条非磁性引线接触。磁矩由非平衡电子分布自洽确定，自旋分辨传输由平均场哈密顿量计算。我们表明，界面磁矩和手性 Rashba 项配合产生大电流极化，再现 CISS 的关键实验特征：高极化、总共四个位点出现阈值，然后是链长干扰调制生长、热抑制和手性反转时的符号反转。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应的自旋界面模型的完全量子公式，该模型在非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式中实现。该模型由具有局域磁矩的金原子组成，通过 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合与手性分子链耦合，并通过两条非磁性引线接触。磁矩由非平衡电子分布自洽确定，自旋分辨传输由平均场哈密顿量计算。我们表明，界面磁矩和手性 Rashba 项配合产生大电流极化，再现 CISS 的关键实验特征：高极化、总共四个位点出现阈值，然后是链长干扰调制生长、热抑制和手性反转时的符号反转。这项工作的核心新成果是将 CISS 效应清楚地分为对自旋电流的偶（非手性）和奇（手性）贡献，IS_z(φ) = IS_zrm eveⁿ(φ) + IS_zrm odd(φ)。我们证明，对于少于四个位点的链，IS_zrm odd 在固定 m_z 处完全消失，对于四个或更多位点的链则变为非零，其中表现出非零奇数部分的最小连接点是四位点几何结构（一个金原子加三个分子位点）。奇怪的部分来自于装置中的互易断裂，该装置同时具有手性、磁不对称（仅在金端的力矩），并且足够长以支持两个或多个 Rashba 活性键。这提供了一种直接的、无参数的测试，来测试观察到的自旋信号是否真正是手性的，还是由非手性自旋阀机制产生的。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Spin Singlet Ground State with Large Excitation Gap in the S = 3/2 quasi-1D van der Waals materials MoX3 (X = I, Br)
full_list.title_zh: S = 3/2 准 1D 范德华材料 MoX3 (X = I, Br) 中具有大激发能隙的量子自旋单线态基态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.12613v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the first experimental evidence for a quantum-disordered spin-singlet ground state and gapped triplon excitations in quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals materials. The insulating van der Waals trihalides MoI3 and MoBr3 are analyzed in a combined thermodynamic, spectroscopic, and theoretical investigation. These materials contain structurally dimerized atomic chains of face-sharing octahedra with alternating short and long Mo-Mo separations along the chain direction. Temperature-dependent bulk magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a broad thermally activated response consistent with a large spin gap. Inelastic neutron scattering (INS) spectra provide direct evidence of a collective spin gap at an exceptionally large energy transfer of ~ 30 meV (~ 348 K) for MoBr3. The absence of low-energy magnetic spectral weight and the activated susceptibility are inconsistent with a conventional classical antiferromagnetic ground state. Instead, they point to a spin-singlet ground state with a large singlet-triplet excitation gap. To identify the microscopic origin of this gap, we perform density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations on one-dimensional spin chains using exchange constants derived from density functional theory (DFT). The dominance of the single dimer exchange term allows the inter-dimer coupling along the chain and between chains to be treated using perturbation theory. Intrachain exchange lowers the isolated-dimer triplet energy by producing a dispersive triplon band. INS data show the triplon bandwidth to be ~ 20 meV. Interchain coupling produces negligible additional bandwidth on the order of 1 meV. The INS measurements directly establish quantum spin-singlet and triplon physics in MoBr3 with a large singlet-triplet gap on the scale of room temperature, while the susceptibility and theoretical results indicate closely analogous behavior in MoI3.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了准一维范德华材料中量子无序自旋单重基态和带隙三重子激发的第一个实验证据。通过热力学、光谱和理论研究相结合的方式对绝缘范德华三卤化物 MoI3 和 MoBr3 进行分析。这些材料包含结构二聚化的共面八面体原子链，沿链方向具有交替的短和长 Mo-Mo 间隔。与温度相关的整体磁化率测量揭示了与大自旋间隙一致的广泛热激活响应。非弹性中子散射 (INS) 谱提供了 MoBr3 在 ~ 30 meV (~ 348 K) 异常大能量转移时集体自旋间隙的直接证据。

full_list.title_en: Stacking-Induced Tuning of a Flat-Band Surface State in NbIrTe4
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Stacking-Induced Tuning of a Flat-Band Surface State in NbIrTe4
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ternary layered transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) offer high tunability and access to correlated and topological states. However, like the broader family of layered TMDCs, their properties are sensitive to stacking order and interlayer coupling. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and surface states of NbIrTe₄, a candidate Weyl semimetal in bulk, and predicted to be a quantum spin Hall insulator in monolayer form. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density-functional theory (DFT), we attribute the strong resonance in tunnelling spectroscopy located approximately 8 meV below the Fermi level to a surface-derived flat band which shows sensitivity to the local stacking order at the surface. In regions where the top layer is laterally shifted, tunnelling spectroscopy instead shows a gap-like feature with intensity near the Fermi level shifted in energy. Combining DFT and quasiparticle interference (QPI) measurements, we find this dramatic change in the spectroscopy in the vicinity of the quasi-1D flat-band surface state becomes dispersive due to a change in the spatial distribution of the density of states in the top two layers. These findings establish NbIrTe₄ as a platform where surface band dispersion can be effectively tuned through local structural manipulation.

full_list.title_en: Time-Reversal Symmetry in Artificial Topological Graphene Rings
full_list.title_zh: 人工拓扑石墨烯环的时间反演对称性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an artificial graphene ring described by the low-energy two-valley Dirac Hamiltonian with a uniform mass term. When the ring is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux, the problem reduces to a second-order radial equation solved by Bessel functions. We give the exact secular equation and, for narrow rings, closed expressions for the spectrum and the persistent current. We then add a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the plane. The radial problem is solved with confluent hypergeometric functions, and the persistent current and magnetization are written as derivatives of a secular determinant from which the spurious roots have been removed. Besides the usual orbital coupling, the field enters through a valley-dependent term that comes from the Dirac structure and lifts the valley degeneracy. A weak-field expansion, accurate up to corrections of order B⁴, gives this valley splitting explicitly and separates the diamagnetic and paramagnetic contributions to the susceptibility. Finally, we work out what time reversal implies for the spectrum. Physical time reversal, which exchanges the valleys, leads to an exact relation between levels at opposite fields. The effective single-valley time reversal, on the other hand, is broken by the mass term and by the boundary conditions, yet leaves no trace in the zero-field spectrum. Numerical results for the spectrum, the persistent current, and the magnetization illustrate the analysis.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由具有均匀质量项的低能双谷狄拉克哈密顿量描述的人造石墨烯环。当环上有阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量时，问题简化为由贝塞尔函数求解的二阶径向方程。我们给出了精确的世俗方程，并且对于窄环，给出了频谱和持续电流的闭合表达式。然后我们添加一个垂直于平面的均匀磁场。径向问题通过汇合超几何函数来解决，并且持续电流和磁化强度被写为长期行列式的导数，其中杂散根已被删除。除了通常的轨道耦合之外，场还通过来自狄拉克结构的谷相关项进入并提升谷简并性。

full_list.title_en: Theoretical Description of Electronic Modulation and Superconducting Coherence
full_list.title_zh: 电子调制和超导相干性的理论描述
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.03368v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An electronic modulation can retain a substantial local amplitude while its translational coherence is limited by spatial disorder. Its coupling to superconductivity therefore cannot be characterized by a single modulation intensity. We develop a phenomenological formulation of a finite-wave-vector complex electronic envelope coupled to a charged superconducting field. Translation and gauge symmetries constrain the interaction terms, while amplitude, modulation-gradient and condensate-gradient couplings act on distinct responses. The resulting variational equations give uniform coexistence conditions, local stability criteria and phase-gradient coefficients. We define the helicity modulus by a boundary twist, distinguish phase-only from amplitude-weighted correlations, and give an explicit minimal spectral Hamiltonian illustrating how the electronic texture may enter momentum-resolved measurements. The proposed tests use distinct spatial, spectral and stiffness observables; none assumes that a tunnelling gap directly measures condensate amplitude. An explicit kernel expansion yields the leading displacement of the selected wave vector, while the thermodynamic twist response determines phase rigidity independently of charge intensity. The analytical relations and selected numerical responses distinguish amplitude, spatial organization and condensate rigidity within the specified coupled-field model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子调制可以保留相当大的局部幅度，而其平移相干性受到空间无序的限制。因此，它与超导的耦合不能用单一的调制强度来表征。我们开发了耦合到带电超导场的有限波矢量复电子包络的唯象公式。平移和规范对称性限制了相互作用项，而振幅、调制梯度和凝聚梯度耦合则作用于不同的响应。由此产生的变分方程给出了均匀共存条件、局部稳定性准则和相位梯度系数。我们通过边界扭曲定义螺旋模量，区分仅相位与幅度加权相关性，并给出明确的最小谱哈密顿量，说明电子纹理如何进入动量分辨测量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子调制可以保留相当大的局部幅度，而其平移相干性受到空间无序的限制。因此，它与超导的耦合不能用单一的调制强度来表征。我们开发了耦合到带电超导场的有限波矢量复电子包络的唯象公式。平移和规范对称性限制了相互作用项，而振幅、调制梯度和凝聚梯度耦合则作用于不同的响应。由此产生的变分方程给出了均匀共存条件、局部稳定性准则和相位梯度系数。我们通过边界扭曲定义螺旋模量，区分仅相位与幅度加权相关性，并给出明确的最小谱哈密顿量，说明电子纹理如何进入动量分辨测量。所提出的测试使用不同的空间、光谱和刚度可观测值；没有一个假设隧道间隙直接测量凝结水振幅。显式核展开产生所选波矢量的前导位移，而热力学扭曲响应决定与电荷强度无关的相刚度。分析关系和选定的数值响应区分指定耦合场模型内的振幅、空间组织和凝结水刚性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《电子调制和超导相干性的理论描述》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Ballistic transport and crystallographic control in altermagnetic quantum rings
full_list.title_zh: 互磁量子环中的弹道输运和晶体控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study coherent two-terminal transport through a finite-width d-wave altermagnetic quantum ring with nonmagnetic leads. A confined Aharonov--Bohm flux remains exactly h/e periodic and, in the symmetric one-mode geometry, produces an exact half-flux transmission zero. A perpendicular field shifts the interference pattern according to an effective area Aᵣₘ ₑff=1.0342,π r₀² and the altermagnetic splitting resolves the common zero into nearby spin-dependent nodes. Rotating the crystal reverses the transmitted spin, whereas the mirror orientation θ_A=π/4 is exactly spin degenerate. For a 50~nm reference ring, sub-tesla fields yield windows with |P_T|>0.99, the most accessible of which requires a uniform field alone and no confined flux. Finite-bias, thermal, disorder, Zeeman, and spin-conserving voltage-probe calculations show that the polarization is appreciably more stable than individual coherent-resonance amplitudes. These results identify interference-node positions, flux periodicity, and crystal-controlled spin polarization as experimentally useful signatures of an altermagnetic mesoscopic interferometer.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究通过具有非磁性引线的有限宽度 d 波交磁量子环的相干两端传输。受限的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量完全保持 h/e 周期性，并且在对称单模几何结构中，产生精确的半通量传输零。垂直场根据有效面积 Aᵣₘ ₑff=1.0342,π r₀² 移动干涉图案，并且交变磁分裂将公共零分解为附近的自旋相关节点。旋转晶体会反转传输的自旋，而镜子方向 θ_A=π/4 恰好是自旋简并。

full_list.title_en: Capturing Open Quantum System Dynamics with Compact Dressed Hamiltonians
full_list.title_zh: 使用紧凑的哈密顿量捕获开放量子系统动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28358v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We advance the compact dressed Hamiltonian (CDH) framework to simulate the dynamics of open quantum systems strongly coupled to structured bosonic environments. The CDH approach combines reaction-coordinate mapping with a polaron transformation, incorporating strong system-environment hybridization into a dressed representation before truncating the collective bosonic mode. As a result of this truncation, dynamical features are captured with substantially fewer states than in the original representation. The residual environment is treated using a weak-coupling Markovian quantum master equation. We benchmark the method for spin-boson-type models including a single spin, coupled spins, and spin ensembles, considering both resonant and off-resonant regimes and weak to strong system-bath coupling. Comparisons with hierarchical equations of motion and converged reaction-coordinate calculations demonstrate that the CDH representation systematically approaches the reference dynamics with a compact Hilbert space, accurately reproducing oscillation frequencies, relaxation behavior, and long-time populations over a broad parameter regime. The method further captures cooperative phenomena, including bath-mediated interactions, synchronization between spins, and signatures for collective emission. Beyond efficient time propagation, the CDH framework provides direct access to the spectrum and eigenmodes of the Liouvillian. We demonstrate that slow dynamical modes converge rapidly in the CDH representation, enabling identification of relaxation timescales without fitting time-dependent observables. As a whole, the CDH framework provides an efficient and physical description of strongly coupled open quantum-system dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们改进了紧凑的哈密顿（CDH）框架来模拟与结构化玻色环境强耦合的开放量子系统的动力学。 CDH 方法将反应坐标映射与极化子变换相结合，在截断集体玻色子模式之前将强大的系统环境杂化纳入修饰的表示中。由于这种截断，动态特征被捕获的状态比原始表示中的状态少得多。使用弱耦合马尔可夫量子主方程处理残余环境。我们对自旋玻色子型模型的方法进行了基准测试，包括单自旋、耦合自旋和自旋系综，同时考虑共振和非共振状态以及弱到强的系统浴耦合。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们改进了紧凑的哈密顿（CDH）框架来模拟与结构化玻色环境强耦合的开放量子系统的动力学。 CDH 方法将反应坐标映射与极化子变换相结合，在截断集体玻色子模式之前将强大的系统环境杂化纳入修饰的表示中。由于这种截断，动态特征被捕获的状态比原始表示中的状态少得多。使用弱耦合马尔可夫量子主方程处理残余环境。我们对自旋玻色子型模型的方法进行了基准测试，包括单自旋、耦合自旋和自旋系综，同时考虑共振和非共振状态以及弱到强的系统浴耦合。与分层运动方程和收敛反应坐标计算的比较表明，CDH 表示通过紧凑的希尔伯特空间系统地接近参考动力学，在广泛的参数范围内准确地再现振荡频率、弛豫行为和长期总体。该方法进一步捕获合作现象，包括浴介导的相互作用、自旋之间的同步以及集体发射的特征。除了有效的时间传播之外，CDH 框架还提供对刘维尔频谱和本征模的直接访问。我们证明慢动态模式在 CDH 表示中快速收敛，从而无需拟合与时间相关的可观测值即可识别弛豫时间尺度。总体而言，CDH 框架提供了强耦合开放量子系统动力学的有效物理描述。

full_list.title_en: Contrasting Crystal-Field and Dipolar Anisotropies in the Triangular Antiferromagnet NaBaEr(BO₃)₂
full_list.title_zh: 对比三角形反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的晶体场和偶极各向异性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic ground states of rare-earth frustrated magnets can be governed by competing energy scales arising from crystal-field anisotropy, exchange interactions, and long-range dipolar interactions. Here we investigate this interplay in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet NaBaEr(BO₃)₂ by combining magnetization, specific heat, and neutron scattering measurements. Neutron powder diffraction resolves rotations of the ErO₆ octahedra and supports the lower-symmetry Rbar3 structure over the previously proposed Rbar3m model. Magnetization measurements and inelastic neutron scattering establish an effective spin-1/2 description of its low-temperature magnetism with pronounced easy-axis anisotropy, arising from a well-isolated Kramers ground-state doublet separated from the first excited crystal-electric-field level by approximately 4 meV. Below Tᵣₘ N=0.1 K, single-crystal neutron diffraction reveals A-type antiferromagnetic order with the ordered moment predominantly oriented within the ab plane, despite the pronounced paramagnetic easy-axis anisotropy. The estimated dipolar interaction scale is comparable to Tᵣₘ N, and classical dipolar-energy calculations for the observed stacking pattern favor an in-plane moment orientation. These results reveal contrasting crystal-field and dipolar anisotropies in determining the magnetic ground state of NaBaEr(BO₃)₂.
full_list.abstract_zh: 稀土受挫磁体的磁基态可以通过晶体场各向异性、交换相互作用和长程偶极相互作用产生的竞争能级来控制。在这里，我们通过结合磁化强度、比热和中子散射测量来研究三角晶格反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的这种相互作用。中子粉末衍射解析了 ErO₆ 八面体的旋转，并支持先前提出的 Rbar3m 模型的低对称性 Rbar3 结构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 稀土受挫磁体的磁基态可以通过晶体场各向异性、交换相互作用和长程偶极相互作用产生的竞争能级来控制。在这里，我们通过结合磁化强度、比热和中子散射测量来研究三角晶格反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的这种相互作用。中子粉末衍射解析了 ErO₆ 八面体的旋转，并支持先前提出的 Rbar3m 模型的低对称性 Rbar3 结构。磁化测量和非弹性中子散射建立了对其低温磁性的有效自旋 1/2 描述，具有明显的易轴各向异性，源于与第一激发晶体电场水平分离约 4 meV 的良好隔离的克莱默基态双峰。在 Tᵣₘ N=0.1 K 以下，单晶中子衍射揭示了 A 型反铁磁序，尽管顺磁易轴各向异性明显，但有序矩主要定向在 ab 平面内。估计的偶极相互作用尺度与 Tᵣₘ N 相当，观察到的堆积模式的经典偶极能量计算有利于面内力矩方向。这些结果揭示了在确定 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 的磁性基态时对比的晶体场和偶极各向异性。
full_list.summary: 稀土受挫磁体的磁基态可以通过晶体场各向异性、交换相互作用和长程偶极相互作用产生的竞争能级来控制。在这里，我们通过结合磁化强度、比热和中子散射测量来研究三角晶格反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的这种相互作用。中子粉末衍射解析了 ErO₆ 八面体的旋转，并支持先前提出的 Rbar3m 模型的低对称性 Rbar3 结构。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《对比三角形反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的晶体场和偶极各向异性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Cumulative locality governs collective quantum charging
full_list.title_zh: 累积局部性控制集体量子充电
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28614v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum batteries can outperform their classical counterparts through collective quantum effects, yet the conditions enabling such advantage remain unclear. Using a generic class of free-fermionic chargers we prove that global operators are insufficient for scalable superextensive charging and that a cumulative hierarchy of many-body operators is required, with the structure of the battery determining the degree of advantage. This is obtained by relating the charging power to the norm of the commutator between the battery and charger Hamiltonians and deriving an upper bound only capturing noncommuting terms. Moreover, we revisit the concept of participation number and propose an effective definition that accounts for the relative strength of the contributing terms, correlating it with the charging power scaling. Not limited to quadratic Hamiltonians, our results establish cumulative locality as a key resource for quantum charging advantage.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子电池可以通过集体量子效应超越经典电池，但实现这种优势的条件仍不清楚。使用通用类自由费米子充电器，我们证明全球运营商不足以进行可扩展的超广泛充电，并且需要多体运营商的累积层次结构，而电池的结构决定了优势程度。这是通过将充电功率与电池和充电器哈密顿量之间的换向器范数相关联并导出仅捕获非换向项的上限来获得的。此外，我们重新审视了参与数量的概念，并提出了一个有效的定义，该定义考虑了贡献项的相对强度，并将其与充电功率缩放相关联。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子电池可以通过集体量子效应超越经典电池，但实现这种优势的条件仍不清楚。使用通用类自由费米子充电器，我们证明全球运营商不足以进行可扩展的超广泛充电，并且需要多体运营商的累积层次结构，而电池的结构决定了优势程度。这是通过将充电功率与电池和充电器哈密顿量之间的换向器范数相关联并导出仅捕获非换向项的上限来获得的。此外，我们重新审视了参与数量的概念，并提出了一个有效的定义，该定义考虑了贡献项的相对强度，并将其与充电功率缩放相关联。不仅限于二次哈密顿量，我们的结果将累积局部性确立为量子充电优势的关键资源。
full_list.summary: 量子电池可以通过集体量子效应超越经典电池，但实现这种优势的条件仍不清楚。使用通用类自由费米子充电器，我们证明全球运营商不足以进行可扩展的超广泛充电，并且需要多体运营商的累积层次结构，而电池的结构决定了优势程度。这是通过将充电功率与电池和充电器哈密顿量之间的换向器范数相关联并导出仅捕获非换向项的上限来获得的。此外，我们重新审视了参与数量的概念，并提出了一个有效的定义，该定义考虑了贡献项的相对强度，并将其与充电功率缩放相关联。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《累积局部性控制集体量子充电》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Finite-size spin fluctuations and fixed-index sweeps in a ferromagnetic spinor condensate
full_list.title_zh: 铁磁旋量凝聚中的有限尺寸自旋涨落和固定折射率扫描
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find a dip in the optimized rotation quantum Fisher information of a zero-magnetization ferromagnetic spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate near the excited-state quantum phase transition. Its displacement from ϵ_c=-q decreases on an inverse-size scale. At q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2, the dip value of Fₘₐₓ equals 2langle S²rangle for N up to 3840, linking it to total-spin fluctuations. A semiclassical orbit average normalized by the classical density of states describes the dip over N=120--3840 with maximum relative residual below 0.028; a small power law fits comparably. Inserting the measured energy offsets directly into the semiclassical formula leaves residuals of 17--30%, so κ acts as an effective cutoff. Among retained states, spin-nematic squeezing occurs at the spectral edges. Separately, fixed-index excited-state sweeps have half-excitation times between 11.2 and 13.1 times their ground-state counterparts, with local size exponents increasing across the four sizes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们发现零磁化铁磁自旋 1 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的优化旋转量子费希尔信息在激发态量子相变附近出现了下降。它从 ϵ_c=-q 的位移按反尺寸减小。在 q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2 处，Fₘₐₓ 的倾角值等于 2langle S²rangle（N 最大为 3840），将其与总自旋波动联系起来。由经典状态密度归一化的半经典轨道平均值描述了 N=120--3840 上的倾角，最大相对残差低于 0.028；小幂律也同样适用。
