full_list.title_en: Generation of non-Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions during thermalization of interacting baths
full_list.title_zh: 相互作用浴热化过程中非麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的生成
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27369v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We report on numerical experiments of thermalization between two reservoirs in which interspecies interactions are mediated via a Hamiltonian with a Gaussian dependence upon the distance between the particles. By using relatively high statistics, we are able to study deviations from the initially imprinted Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions as a function of the range and strength of the interaction, as well as the parameters of the two baths such as masses, trapping frequencies, that strongly affect the spatial overlap of the two species. At large interaction strengths and for any range, deviations are attributable to the sudden conversion of latent interaction energy into kinetic energy of the particles. In addition, long range interactions generate deviations even for interaction strengths in the weak regime, and non-uniform confinement introduces a further source of deviation from the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distribution. This latter results in transient two temperature Maxwell-Boltzmann distributions suggestive of an inverse cascading route from inter-particle dynamics to thermalization. In the weakly-interacting regime, a simple expression for the equilibrium temperature is also obtained and discussed. These findings may be of relevance in the dynamics of exothermic chemical reactions, in the physics of ultracold atomic mixtures, and in self-sustained burning plasmas.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了两个储层之间热化的数值实验，其中种间相互作用是通过哈密顿量介导的，其高斯依赖于粒子之间的距离。通过使用相对较高的统计数据，我们能够研究与最初印记的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差，作为相互作用的范围和强度的函数，以及两个浴的参数，例如质量、捕获频率，这些参数强烈影响两个物种的空间重叠。在大相互作用强度和任何范围内，偏差可归因于潜在相互作用能突然转换为粒子的动能。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了两个储层之间热化的数值实验，其中种间相互作用是通过哈密顿量介导的，其高斯依赖于粒子之间的距离。通过使用相对较高的统计数据，我们能够研究与最初印记的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差，作为相互作用的范围和强度的函数，以及两个浴的参数，例如质量、捕获频率，这些参数强烈影响两个物种的空间重叠。在大相互作用强度和任何范围内，偏差可归因于潜在相互作用能突然转换为粒子的动能。此外，即使对于弱状态下的相互作用强度，长程相互作用也会产生偏差，并且非均匀限制引入了与麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差的进一步来源。后者导致瞬态两个温度麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布，暗示从粒子间动力学到热化的逆级联路线。在弱相互作用状态下，还获得并讨论了平衡温度的简单表达式。这些发现可能与放热化学反应的动力学、超冷原子混合物的物理学以及自持燃烧等离子体有关。
full_list.summary: 我们报告了两个储层之间热化的数值实验，其中种间相互作用是通过哈密顿量介导的，其高斯依赖于粒子之间的距离。通过使用相对较高的统计数据，我们能够研究与最初印记的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差，作为相互作用的范围和强度的函数，以及两个浴的参数，例如质量、捕获频率，这些参数强烈影响两个物种的空间重叠。在大相互作用强度和任何范围内，偏差可归因于潜在相互作用能突然转换为粒子的动能。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《相互作用浴热化过程中非麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的生成》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: High-Field and Light-Dependent Magnetization Provides Evidence for Coexisting Granular Superconductivity and Superparamagnetism in Nitrogen-Doped Diamond
full_list.title_zh: 高场和光相关磁化为掺氮金刚石中共存的颗粒超导性和超顺磁性提供了证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the field-, temperature-, and time-dependent magnetic moment of a nitrogen-doped type Ib diamond in darkness and under monochromatic light with a low laser intensity of about 160 μW cm⁻². In darkness, below approximately 25 K, the magnetic moment exhibits unconventional hysteresis loops that can be explained by the coexistence of superparamagnetism and superconductivity in certain regions of the sample. Under illumination, this hysteresis largely disappears, leaving mainly the superparamagnetic contribution. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal an irreversibility below 25 K in darkness, which vanishes under illumination. Similarly, at 0.5 T and below 25 K, the time-dependent magnetization shows flux-creep-like behavior that disappears when the sample is illuminated. All light-induced changes are fully reversible: the magnetic properties measured in darkness are restored after the sample is heated above roughly 50 K. Removing the superparamagnetic contribution from magnetization measurements up to ± 14 T reveals clear characteristics of a granular superconductor, namely, a well-defined penetration field Hₚ approx 2.6 T and a critical field Hc₂ approx 10.6 T. Based on theoretical considerations, we attribute the observed phenomena to the combined effects of internal stress and local variations in nitrogen concentration within localized regions that can be regarded as grains. This interpretation is supported by Raman and birefringence spectroscopy measurements on the same sample.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了氮掺杂 Ib 型金刚石在黑暗中和单色光下（约 160 μW cm-2 的低激光强度）的场、温度和时间依赖性磁矩。在黑暗中，低于约 25 K，磁矩表现出非常规的磁滞回线，这可以通过样品某些区域中超顺磁性和超导性的共存来解释。在照明下，这种磁滞大部分消失，主要留下超顺磁性的贡献。与温度相关的测量揭示了在黑暗中低于 25 K 时的不可逆性，在光照下会消失。

full_list.title_en: Nambu-Goldstone Bosons and Quantum Fisher Information
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nambu-Goldstone Bosons and Quantum Fisher Information
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Fisher matrix and geometric tensor are powerful tools for quantifying the nature of quantum systems. Unfortunately, the formalism needed to compute these quantities is opaque and has limited the development of physical intuition for their behavior, even in the ground state. For quantum systems with continuous symmetries, we know the ground state can be understood in a model-independent and intuitive way from the correlation functions of conserved currents and charges. In this paper, we demonstrate an equivalence between the quantum Fisher matrix associated with the ground states of systems with continuous symmetries and the Nambu-Goldstone. bosons produced by broken generators. We will show that the information metric defined by the Fisher matrix is the same as the Zamolodchikov metric that defines the coset space of the system. Next we show that the Uhlmann curvature associated with multi-parameter estimation is the same as the charge density matrix that defines the difference between type-A and type-B Nambu-Goldstone bosons. We demonstrate these connections in several examples and discuss the generalization to finite temperature.

full_list.title_en: Spin-wave circulation in unbounded ferromagnetic film
full_list.title_zh: 无界铁磁薄膜中的自旋波循环
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key challenge in spin-wave computing is steering spin waves through circuits without wave distortion or reflections. This often results in 1D propagation scenarios, which hinder applicability in 2D magnonic circuits. We demonstrate experimentally a novel approach using a hard magnetic spherical microparticle to guide spin-waves onto a closed path in a plain thin YIG film. The particle stray field induces a radially symmetrical magnetization landscape, which allows spin-waves to loop around. In parallel, we conducted micromagnetic simulations reproducing the experimental conditions, which confirm the circulation of spin-waves over several loops around the particle. This work demonstrates the possibility to steer spin-waves onto a circular path using inhomogeneous magnetic landscape, as well as advancing scalable spin-wave-based information processing technologies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋波计算的一个关键挑战是引导自旋波通过电路而不发生波畸变或反射。这通常会导致一维传播场景，从而阻碍了二维磁路的适用性。我们通过实验证明了一种新方法，使用硬磁球形微粒将自旋波引导到平面 YIG 薄膜中的闭合路径上。粒子杂散场会产生径向对称的磁化景观，从而允许自旋波循环。与此同时，我们进行了微磁模拟，重现了实验条件，证实了自旋波在粒子周围的几个环上的循环。这项工作展示了利用非均匀磁景观将自旋波引导到圆形路径上的可能性，以及先进的基于可扩展的自旋波的信息处理技术。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《无界铁磁薄膜中的自旋波循环》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Sum-over-poles framework for quantum embedding to approach the real-frequency axis
full_list.title_zh: 用于接近真实频率轴的量子嵌入的极点求和框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a real-frequency framework for the quantum embedding of solids, based on sum-over-poles (SOP) representations. We partition the lattice into periodically repeated interacting fragments and derive an embedded Dyson equation for the fragment, to be solved self-consistently. The resulting scheme generalizes the algorithmic-inversion method of our previous work to interacting Hamiltonians and is closely related to dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), especially when an extended impurity problem is introduced. By exploiting the compact pole expansion of the embedding potential, we carry out the self-consistent procedure close to the real axis, which avoids ill-posed analytic continuation. In addition, the SOP representation allows us to introduce a pole-and-residue dynamics, which we use to reach the self-consistent solution. After deriving the method, we benchmark it against exact-diagonalization implementations of DMFT on the one-dimensional Hubbard ring at half filling. The framework offers a natural route to real-space dynamical quantum embedding, for periodic systems as well as for strongly correlated defects in materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们引入了基于极点和（SOP）表示的固体量子嵌入的实频框架。我们将晶格划分为周期性重复的相互作用的片段，并导出该片段的嵌入式戴森方程，以自洽地求解。由此产生的方案将我们之前工作的算法反演方法推广到相互作用的哈密顿量，并且与动态平均场理论（DMFT）密切相关，特别是当引入扩展的杂质问题时。通过利用嵌入势的紧极展开，我们在接近实轴的地方执行了自洽过程，这避免了不适定的分析连续。此外，SOP 表示允许我们引入极点和残差动力学，我们用它来达到自洽的解决方案。

full_list.title_en: Suppression and reemergence of directional transport across the ferromagnetic transition in SrRuO₃
full_list.title_zh: SrRuO₃ 中铁磁转变方向定向输运的抑制和重新出现
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: SrRuO₃ is a canonical itinerant ferromagnet that continues to serve as a fertile platform for exploring spin-orbit coupled transport and topological responses in correlated oxide metals. Here, we investigate a (110)-oriented epitaxial SrRuO3 thin film on DyScO₃, where crystallographic anisotropy allows for symmetry-resolved charge transport along orthogonal in-plane directions. We uncover two principal findings. First, the resistance above the Curie temperature Tc,ₒₙapprox 165 K exhibits strong anisotropy, consistent with directionally dependent spin-fluctuation scattering. Below Tc,ₒₙ, this anisotropy nearly vanishes, despite persistent structural inequivalence, due to isotropic electron-magnon and electron-electron scattering processes. Second, the application of a magnetic field reveals a striking directional contrast in the linear magnetoresistance (MR): it remains negative and saturates along [001], but changes sign and becomes positive along [1bar10] below T₀=145 K. In contrast, the quadratic MR term is identical for both directions and peaks near TOHE^*=155 K, where the ordinary Hall coefficient crosses zero, consistent with carrier compensation under a two-band scenario. A sign change in the anomalous Hall signal at TAHE^*=150 K is consistent with a temperature-dependent redistribution of Berry-curvature contributions near the Fermi level. These results establish ferromagnetic ordering as the primary driver of the observed directional magnetotransport in SrRuO₃.
full_list.abstract_zh: SrRuO₃ 是一种典型的流动铁磁体，它继续作为探索相关氧化物金属中自旋轨道耦合输运和拓扑响应的丰富平台。在这里，我们研究了 DyScO₃ 上的 (110) 取向外延 SrRuO3 薄膜，其中晶体各向异性允许沿正交面内方向对称解析电荷传输。我们发现了两个主要发现。首先，高于居里温度 Tc（约 165 K）的电阻表现出很强的各向异性，与方向相关的自旋涨落散射一致。在 Tc,ₒₙ 以下，尽管由于各向同性电子-磁振子和电子-电子散射过程而导致结构持续不平等，但这种各向异性几乎消失。

full_list.title_en: Vortex matter as a magnetically programmable metasurface for tuning near-field radiative heat transfer
full_list.title_zh: 涡旋物质作为磁性可编程超表面，用于调节近场辐射传热
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) is of great interest for energy conversion and thermal management. Recent work on NFRHT has shown that metasurfaces can enhance NFRHT and reshape its spectral characteristics. Here, we show that the vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor represents a self-assembled metasurface whose lattice dimensions, in contrast to most other metasurfaces, can be tuned by magnetic fields, allowing NFRHT to be varied by orders of magnitude. Specifically, we show that for two Nb surfaces at 4.2 K and separated by a 100 nm gap, NFRHT can be magnetically tuned by a factor >200. Further, we show that the tuning range grows upon cooling, exceeding 10⁵ at 2 K, which is far beyond the order-unity modulation of many proposed schemes for tuning NFRHT. Our results establish vortex matter as a magnetically programmable thermal metasurface and open new opportunities for tuning the flow of heat at the nanoscale.
full_list.abstract_zh: 近场辐射传热（NFRHT）对于能量转换和热管理具有重要意义。最近有关 NFRHT 的研究表明，超表面可以增强 NFRHT 并重塑其光谱特性。在这里，我们表明，II 型超导体的涡旋晶格代表了一种自组装的超表面，与大多数其他超表面相比，其晶格尺寸可以通过磁场调节，从而允许 NFRHT 发生几个数量级的变化。具体来说，我们表明，对于 4.2 K 且间隔 100 nm 间隙的两个 Nb 表面，NFRHT 可以通过 >200 的因子进行磁调谐。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 近场辐射传热（NFRHT）对于能量转换和热管理具有重要意义。最近有关 NFRHT 的研究表明，超表面可以增强 NFRHT 并重塑其光谱特性。在这里，我们表明，II 型超导体的涡旋晶格代表了一种自组装的超表面，与大多数其他超表面相比，其晶格尺寸可以通过磁场调节，从而允许 NFRHT 发生几个数量级的变化。具体来说，我们表明，对于 4.2 K 且间隔 100 nm 间隙的两个 Nb 表面，NFRHT 可以通过 >200 的因子进行磁调谐。此外，我们还表明，调谐范围随着冷却而增大，在 2 K 时超过 10⁵，这远远超出了许多提出的用于调谐 NFRHT 方案的阶次单位调制。我们的研究结果将涡旋物质确立为磁性可编程热超表面，并为在纳米尺度上调节热流开辟了新的机会。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《涡旋物质作为磁性可编程超表面，用于调节近场辐射传热》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A high-entropy form of RMn₆Sn₆ with distinct magnetotransport regimes correlated to different magnetic structures
full_list.title_zh: 具有与不同磁性结构相关的不同磁传输机制的高熵形式的RMn * Sn *
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.21633v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The kagome RMn₆Sn₆ material family has attracted significant attention as high-temperature metallic magnets with a host of different magnetic orderings and anisotropy. Theoretical studies point to the rare-earth (R) as the determining factor for both the direction of magnetic anisotropy and the type of magnetic ordering in a given compound. This motivates studying high-entropy forms of RMn₆Sn₆ to examine how the interplay of several rare-earth elements leads to different magnetic states in a single crystal. Here, we present a rare-earth mix of Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, and Lu that produces phase transitions from a paramagnet to an easy-plane ferrimagnet (FiM) below TC = 380 K, then to a FiM easy-axis state at TSR₁ = 207 K, to a canted FiM ground state below TSR₂ = 79 K. This behavior is consistent with previously reported high-entropy RMn₆Sn₆ compounds; however, uniquely, the rare-earth mix studied here exhibits a broad transition from easy-plane to easy-axis anisotropy from 270 K to 170 K, and reveals a nonmonotonic magnetoresistance. Using neutron scattering data, we found that both observations correlate with an incommensurate modulated contribution to the spin state due to competing rare-earth interactions. This magnetoresistive behavior and the correlated spin structures underscore the potential for rare-earth engineering of magnetism.
full_list.abstract_zh: 作为具有许多不同磁性顺序和各向异性的高温金属磁体， KAGOME RMn ”Sn”材料家族引起了广泛的关注。理论研究指出，稀土（ R ）是决定给定化合物中磁各向异性方向和磁有序类型的决定因素。这促使研究高熵形式的RMn Sn Sn ，以研究几种稀土元素的相互作用如何导致单晶中的不同磁态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 作为具有许多不同磁性顺序和各向异性的高温金属磁体， KAGOME RMn ”Sn”材料家族引起了广泛的关注。理论研究指出，稀土（ R ）是决定给定化合物中磁各向异性方向和磁有序类型的决定因素。这促使研究高熵形式的RMn Sn Sn ，以研究几种稀土元素的相互作用如何导致单晶中的不同磁态。在这里，我们提出了一种Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm和Lu的稀土混合物，它产生从TC = 380 K以下的顺磁体到易平面亚铁磁体（ FiM ）的相变，然后在TSR = 207 K时转变为FiM易轴状态，再到TSR ₂ = 79 K以下的倾斜FiM基态。这种行为与先前报道的高熵RMn · Sn ·化合物一致；然而，这里研究的稀土混合物独特地表现出从易平面到易轴各向异性从270 K到170 K的广泛转变，并显示出非单调磁阻。使用中子散射数据，我们发现这两个观测值都与由于竞争稀土相互作用而对自旋状态的不相称调制贡献相关。这种磁阻行为和相关的自旋结构强调了稀土磁性工程的潜力。

full_list.title_en: Direction-dependent magnetoelectric conductivity from dipolar topological semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 双极拓扑半金属的方向相关磁电导率
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.26676v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We compute the linear magnetoelectric conductivity of a two-band vortex nodal-ring (VNR) semimetal and a three-band Hopf semimetal (HSM) within the semiclassical Boltzmann formalism, in the relaxation-time approximation, for three inequivalent planar-Hall configurations, with the electric (boldsymbol E) and magnetic (boldsymbol B) fields oriented differently relative to the nodal-ring plane and the Berry-curvature (BC) dipole axis. Unlike Weyl and multifold semimetals with point-monopole BC flux, the HSM carries a single, point-like BC-dipole fixed at its node, while the VNR hosts a continuous ring of such sources around the nodal loop. Both have vanishing Chern numbers. Working consistently to cubic order in boldsymbol B, we evaluate the Drude, BC, orbital-magnetic-moment (OMM), anomalous-Hall, and Lorentz-force contributions. In both systems, the dipolar BC and OMM activate out-of-plane and odd-in-boldsymbol B in-plane response-channels that are symmetry-forbidden for a BC-monopole. Mirror symmetry confines the odd longitudinal terms to B_z, the field component along the dipole axis. The internode-scattering conductivity of the HSM vanishes identically, since the dipolar BC and OMM are even in momentum and no charge is pumped between two conjugate Hopf nodes, which carry oppositely oriented BC-dipoles. Comparisons with a PT-broken gapped nodal-ring and a pseudospin-1 triple-point semimetal confirm the dipolar-BC origin of these features.

full_list.title_en: Engineering tunable p-wave magnetism in antiferromagnetic bilayers
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁双层中的工程可调谐p波磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.00277v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a symmetry-guided route to engineer tunable p-wave magnetism in a bilayer system composed of two AB-stacked antiferromagnetic square lattices with their collinear moments nonparallel to each other. We show that an in-plane relative shift between the two layers selectively breaks the symmetries protecting spin degeneracy while preserving time-reversal-related constraints, thereby generating odd-parity spin splitting in a fully compensated magnetic state without spin-orbit coupling. The direction and the magnitude of the resulting p-wave spin-splitting, together with the associated spin responses, can be continuously tuned by the in-plane displacement, providing a potential knob for control. We further map the bilayer system onto an effective bond-modulated square lattice and investigate the corresponding Hubbard model within a mean-field framework. The calculated phase diagram reveals extended regions where p-wave magnetism with coplanar or chiral spin textures emerges spontaneously. Our results establish a minimal equilibrium platform for realizing and manipulating p-wave magnetism in two-dimensional systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种对称引导路线，用于在由两个AB叠加的反铁磁方格组成的双层系统中设计可调谐的p波磁性，其共线矩彼此不平行。我们表明，两层之间的面内相对位移选择性地打破了保护自旋退化的对称性，同时保留了与时间反转相关的约束，从而在没有自旋轨道耦合的完全补偿磁态下产生奇偶性自旋分裂。所产生的p波自旋分裂的方向和幅度，以及相关的自旋响应，可以通过平面内位移连续调节，为控制提供潜在的旋钮。我们进一步将双层系统映射到一个有效的键调制方格上，并在平均场框架内研究相应的哈伯德模型。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic exchange interactions in the molecular orbital spin system NaV2O5 from a distributed moment point of view
full_list.title_zh: 从分布矩的角度看分子轨道自旋系统NaV2O5中的磁交换相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.19224v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The magnetism in NaV2O5 results from doping of the narrow split-off conduction band of V2O5, which becomes half-filled and leads to a Mott-insulating splitting of spin resolved bands with anti-ferromagnetic order of the spins along the zigzag chains. In the Pmmn structure the spin of this S = 1/2 system is equally shared between two vanadium atoms, residing in a molecular orbital type state. While below 34 K a charge disproportionation occurs into V4+ and V5+, the situation above this temperature is less clear and amounts to a fluctuating moment with equal probability of occupancy of each V. While traditionally described as a quarter-filled ladder system with electron spin localized on the rungs of the ladder, we here take a distributed moment approach in terms of the spin density lumped into individual atomic magnetic sites, including the small induced moments on the oxygen atoms. Exchange interactions are calculated between these sites using a linear response approach based on quasiparticle-self-consistent GW band structures. Surprisingly we find the exchange interactions between the small magnetic moments induced on the vanadyl and bridge oxygen sites to be larger than the exchange interactions between vanadium atoms. Their role in the critical temperature is found to be crucial. The spin wave spectra obtained from this classical Heisenberg type Hamiltonian contains unusual optic spin wave type collective excitations of high energy, the significance of which is discussed.
full_list.abstract_zh: NaV2O5中的磁性是由V2O5的窄分裂传导带的掺杂产生的，其变为半填充，并导致自旋分辨带的莫特绝缘分裂，自旋沿着锯齿链具有反铁磁顺序。在Pmmn结构中，该S = 1/2系统的自旋在两个钒原子之间均匀共享，处于分子轨道类型状态。当低于34 K时， V4 +和V5 +发生电荷不成比例，高于该温度的情况不太清楚，相当于波动矩，每个V的占有概率相等。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: NaV2O5中的磁性是由V2O5的窄分裂传导带的掺杂产生的，其变为半填充，并导致自旋分辨带的莫特绝缘分裂，自旋沿着锯齿链具有反铁磁顺序。在Pmmn结构中，该S = 1/2系统的自旋在两个钒原子之间均匀共享，处于分子轨道类型状态。当低于34 K时， V4 +和V5 +发生电荷不成比例，高于该温度的情况不太清楚，相当于波动矩，每个V的占有概率相等。虽然传统上被描述为一个四分之一填充的阶梯系统，电子自旋位于阶梯的梯级上，但我们在这里采取了一种分布式力矩方法，将自旋密度集中到单个原子磁场位置，包括氧原子上的小诱导力矩。使用基于准粒子自洽GW带结构的线性响应方法计算这些部位之间的交换相互作用。令人惊讶的是，我们发现在钒酰基和桥氧位点上诱发的小磁矩之间的交换相互作用大于钒原子之间的交换相互作用。它们在临界温度中的作用被认为是至关重要的。从这种经典的海森堡型Hamiltonian中获得的自旋波谱包含不寻常的高能量光学自旋波型集体激发，讨论了其意义。

full_list.title_en: Achieving ultrahigh-temperature superfluidity in atomic Fermi gases by suppressing pairing fluctuations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Achieving ultrahigh-temperature superfluidity in atomic Fermi gases by suppressing pairing fluctuations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26997v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving room-temperature superconductivity has been a long-sought goal of both the physics community and the industry. The superfluid transition temperature T_c of a Fermi system initially increases with increasing pairing strength between fermions following the mean-field prediction of the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory, and is then suppressed by pairing fluctuations as the strength increases further, which prevents T_c from becoming high. Here we propose a mechanism for suppressing pairing fluctuations using the synergy between population imbalance and momentum space confinement in lattice systems, enabling an ultrahigh T_c at moderately strong attraction. We show that in a three-dimensional optical lattice, strong Pauli exclusion between paired and excess majority fermions pushes up the pair excitation energy and suppresses finite-momentum pairing fluctuations. The mechanism is general to any lattice with a finite Brillouin zone; the optimal imbalance is modest (plesssim 0.1), keeping the Zeeman field small and avoiding orbital complications. The gapped pair dispersion at moderate imbalance exponentially suppresses thermal condensate depletion, providing a testable signature. The gapped dispersion, enhanced condensate fraction, and pseudogap reduction are all accessible in present-day experiments. This work opens new avenues toward room-temperature superconductivity.

full_list.title_en: Adiabatic confinement and number-theoretic spectra of massless Dirac fermions in twisted trilayer graphene
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Adiabatic confinement and number-theoretic spectra of massless Dirac fermions in twisted trilayer graphene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrons in graphene move like massless relativistic particles, making them exceptionally mobile but difficult to trap because Klein tunnelling permits unimpeded passage through electrostatic barriers. This challenge extends to atomic collapse and hadron confinement. Twisted trilayers form Bernal and rhombohedral domains joined by smooth boundaries, bringing their carriers into contact. Here we show that a new mechanism, distinct from established approaches, confines massless fermions in equilateral triangular Bernal domains without mass barriers, bulk gaps or physical edges. Simulations and analytical modeling reveal that massless carriers have no adiabatic continuation into rhombohedral domains, while escape through nonadiabatic coupling to massive carriers is exponentially suppressed by smooth stacking variation. Perfect reflection in the adiabatic limit turns Bernal domains into quantum cavities in a gapless, edgeless metal. Striking density-of-states oscillations encode Eisenstein-integer arithmetic, linking energies and degeneracies to norms and prime factorizations. These findings bring relativistic confinement and number theory into experimentally accessible electronic spectra.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Andreev Scattering Driven Surface Photogalvanic Effect
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The surface photogalvanic effect is a powerful tool for generating macroscopic direct currents in centrosymmetric film structures via asymmetric scattering of carriers at film boundaries. Here, we uncover a fundamentally distinct regime of photoinduced transport in normal metal-superconductor heterostructures, in which the macroscopic photocurrent is governed by Andreev scattering at the interface rather than by classical scattering. We demonstrate that the interplay between asymmetric surface scattering and Andreev retroreflection yields a giant, strongly frequency-dependent anomalous photocurrent. Strikingly, the electron-hole conversion at the normal-superconducting interface dictates a macroscopic sign reversal of the photogalvanic current across the superconducting transition, and induces non-analytic spectral kinks exactly at the pairing gap frequency. Our results establish the Andreev reflection-driven surface photogalvanic effect as a platform for optical control of superconducting correlations and suggest a direct, non-invasive spectroscopic probe for gap dynamics in hybrid quantum devices.

full_list.title_en: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. Our results provide a general strategy for exploring and manipulating topological optical states.

full_list.title_zh: RMn6Sn6 kagome 金属（R=Tb、Ho、Er 和 Y）中的手性磁激发。
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent inelastic neutron scattering (INS) investigations of the kagome metal TbMn6Sn6 reveal novel chiral magnetic excitations associated with the kagome layer. These excitations appear to have an itinerant character with a large energy scale (> 100 meV) and heavy damping; however, the origin of these excitations, which are not predicted by local moment linear spin-wave theory, is not understood. Here, we use INS to show that chiral excitations are also found in RMn6Sn6 compounds with R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y having uniaxial, tilted, planar ferrimagnet, and planar double-spiral magnetic structures, respectively. Thus, the chiral excitations exist regardless of the magnetic structure. Additionally, R=Er and Y demonstrate that the chiral mode intensity is weaker in planar magnetic structures, suggesting that excitations are transverse to the local Mn moment direction. The chiral excitations appear only at L=odd positions in the Brilloun zone, and correspond to chiral spin exciations of the same handedness within each kagome layer, and pi out-of-phase between layers.

full_list.title_en: Classical spin liquids in the kagome Ising model, and their link with magnetoelasticity
full_list.title_zh: Kagome Ising 模型中的经典自旋液体及其与磁弹性的联系
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a nearest-neighbor Ising model on the kagome lattice coupled to elastic lattice distortions. By integrating out the lattice degrees of freedom, we derive an approximate spin-only description in terms of a kagome (J₁)-(J₂)-(J₃) Ising model with interactions extending to third nearest-neighbors. Using tensor network methods complemented by classical Monte Carlo simulations, we revisit its zero-temperature phase diagram and characterize the ground states studied more than thirty years ago. We discover three phases with extensive zero-temperature entropy and algebraically decaying spin correlations. Importantly, these states are not confined to fine-tuned points or frontiers between phases, but occupy extended areas of parameter space. Their quasi long-range order is reflected in Bragg-like peaks in the structure factors; we relate this, and other properties, to diverse phases found in Ising and Heisenberg models. Finally, we trace the trajectories generated by the magnetoelastic coupling through the effective-model phase diagram, explaining the emergence of self-frustration for the unfrustrated magnetoelastic model with ferromagnetic interactions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与弹性晶格畸变耦合的 kagome 晶格上的最近邻 Ising 模型。通过积分晶格自由度，我们根据 kagome (J₁)-(J2)-(J₃) Ising 模型推导出近似的仅自旋描述，其相互作用延伸到第三个最近邻。使用张量网络方法并辅以经典蒙特卡罗模拟，我们重新审视了其零温度相图并表征了三十多年前研究的基态。我们发现了具有广泛的零温熵和代数衰减自旋相关性的三个阶段。重要的是，这些状态并不局限于阶段之间的微调点或边界，而是占据参数空间的扩展区域。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Kagome Ising 模型中的经典自旋液体及其与磁弹性的联系》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Classical-to-Quantum Transition in Blackbody Radiation Thermodynamics: Planck's Law without Statistical Assumptions
full_list.title_zh: 黑体辐射热力学中的经典到量子转变：没有统计假设的普朗克定律
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by Fermi's model of radiation-matter interaction, we investigate the classical dynamics of a closed, finite-energy system, in which matter is coupled to an electromagnetic field. We find that energy is progressively transferred to increasingly high-frequency field modes, so that the effective temperature of both matter and radiation approaches zero in the long-time limit - in sharp contradiction with the finite-temperature equilibrium assumed by classical blackbody thermodynamics. Requiring consistency with the Stefan-Boltzmann and Wien laws identifies a characteristic time t_L, at which both laws are simultaneously satisfied. Strikingly, classical spectra obtained for different energies and cavity sizes collapse onto the universal Planck distribution at t_L. We conjecture that quantum dynamical localization arrests the classical energy cascade at t_L, and that the Planck distribution emerges as a dynamical consequence of this arrest - without invoking any a priori statistical assumption.
full_list.abstract_zh: 受费米辐射与物质相互作用模型的启发，我们研究了封闭有限能量系统的经典动力学，其中物质与电磁场耦合。我们发现能量逐渐转移到越来越高频的场模式，使得物质和辐射的有效温度在长时间极限内接近于零——这与经典黑体热力学假设的有限温度平衡形成鲜明矛盾。要求与斯蒂芬-玻尔兹曼定律和维恩定律保持一致，确定了两个定律同时满足的特征时间 t_L。引人注目的是，针对不同能量和腔尺寸获得的经典光谱在 t_L 处崩溃到通用普朗克分布。

full_list.title_en: Collective Hall quantization in 3D Chern vector systems
full_list.title_zh: 3D Chern 矢量系统中的集体霍尔量化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the three-dimensional (3D) quantum Hall effect, characterized by a Chern vector rather than a single Chern number, has been a central pursuit in topological physics. While quantized Hall transport is established for the special case with one nonzero Chern component, recent realizations of more general Chern-vector states raise a fundamental question: how does such topology protect quantized transport? Here, we predict a distinct 3D quantized Hall effect protected by C=(0,m,n). For samples with dimensions L_y and L_z, global topology enforces collective quantization of mL_y+nL_z, despite the fragility of individual edge modes to disorder. This reveals a novel transport regime in which robust quantization emerges as a holistic property of a unified chiral network,rather than of its constituent modes. Crucially, this collective response manifests as a quantized Hall conductance Gₓy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h, with a distinctive dependence on both Chern-vector components and sample dimensions. We propose candidate materials to facilitate experimental observation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 了解三维 (3D) 量子霍尔效应（以陈矢量而不是单个陈数为特征）一直是拓扑物理学的核心追求。虽然量化霍尔传输是针对具有一个非零陈组件的特殊情况建立的，但最近对更一般的陈矢量状态的实现提出了一个基本问题：这种拓扑如何保护量化传输？在这里，我们预测受 C=(0,m,n) 保护的独特 3D 量化霍尔效应。对于尺寸为 L_y 和 L_z 的样本，全局拓扑强制执行 mL_y+nL_z 的集体量化，尽管各个边缘模式对无序的脆弱性。

full_list.title_en: Connecting the Hydrodynamics of Polymeric Fluids and Active Nematics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Connecting the Hydrodynamics of Polymeric Fluids and Active Nematics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.08296v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We establish a correspondence between the continuum descriptions of polymer solutions and active nematics, two seemingly disparate but well-studied complex fluids. Through a mapping of the governing equations, we demonstrate that polymeric fluids can be interpreted as deformable, contractile, high-temperature active nematics, with an effective activity controlled by polymer extension. Using numerical simulations under Kolmogorov flow, we construct a phase diagram connecting the nematic and polymer limits, highlighting how their one- and two-dimensional instabilities depend on deformability. This encompasses both a flow-suppressed regime, in which active stresses oppose the imposed flow, and a transverse instability that generates secondary flows and leads towards elastic turbulence. The transverse instability is facilitated by spatial gradients in activity, which arise naturally in extensible polymers through variations in chain extension. We further show that the transition into the well-known traveling arrowhead structures in elastic turbulence is marked by the emergence of charge ± 1/2 topological defects in the polymer director field, indicating emergent nematic ordering of stretched polymers. Our results establish a unified framework connecting polymer and active matter hydrodynamics, with implications for low-Reynolds-number turbulence, active polymer systems, and the mechanics of deformable living matter.

full_list.title_en: Correlated emission of electron-current waves
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Correlated emission of electron-current waves
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2505.24052v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Correlated emission of light offers a potential avenue for entanglement generation between atomic spins, with potential application for sensing and quantum memory. In this work, we investigate the conditions for the correlated emission by color centers into an electronic bath of conduction electrons. Unlike emission into bosonic modes, electrons can absorb energy via two-particle processes across a large range of length scales. We find that two length scales are particularly relevant in a clean system: one set by the Fermi velocity and the frequency of the color centers v_F/Δ, and the other set by the Fermi wavelength λ_F ll v_F/Δ. Subradiance requires emitters to be spaced at a distance closer than the Fermi wavelength, while superradiance requires spacing less than sqrtλ_F v_F/Δ, so long as the emitters are initialized with coherence. We show that the emitted current burst has a spiral form, and we discuss the experimental possibility to observe correlated dissipation by color-center qubits coupled to electronic environments.

full_list.title_en: Direct Urca process facilitated by non-Fermi-liquid quantum criticality
full_list.title_zh: 非费米液体量子临界促进直接 Urca 过程
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28023v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional Fermi-liquid theories of dense nuclear matter predict that the direct Urca process requires a proton fraction above a threshold of Yₚ approx 0.11--0.15, which is rarely reached in low-mass neutron stars. Here we show that this stringent kinematic constraint is drastically relaxed by the non-Fermi liquid behavior arising from superfluid and superconducting quantum criticality in neutron stars. In the non-Fermi-liquid regimes, nucleons have a smooth momentum occupation without a sharp Fermi surface, and their chemical potentials develop a logarithmic temperature dependence. These intrinsic features fundamentally alter the standard β-equilibrium relation. Consequently, direct Urca neutrino emission can be activated even at low nuclear densities. This modifies the long-standing Urca-threshold paradigm and indicates that direct Urca process has the opportunity to occur in low-mass neutron stars.
full_list.abstract_zh: 传统的致密核物质费米液体理论预测，直接的 Urca 过程需要质子分数高于 Yₚ 阈值约 0.11--0.15，这在低质量中子星中很少达到。在这里，我们表明，中子星中超流体和超导量子临界性产生的非费米液体行为大大放松了这种严格的运动学约束。在非费米液体体系中，核子具有平滑的动量占据，没有尖锐的费米表面，并且它们的化学势发展出对数温度依赖性。这些内在特征从根本上改变了标准的β-平衡关系。因此，即使在低核密度下也可以激活乌卡中微子的直接发射。

full_list.title_en: Electronic driving of torsional modes in carbon nanotubes via orbital-phonon coupling
full_list.title_zh: 通过轨道声子耦合电子驱动碳纳米管扭转模式
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate electronic driving of a torsional mode in a suspended carbon nanotube quantum dot. The valley states in a nanotube carry opposite orbital magnetic moments along the tube axis, and intervalley mixing forms valley-mixed eigenstates whose splitting can be controlled by an axial magnetic field. We formulate an orbital-rotation coupling between the torsional angular velocity and the valley orbital angular momentum. Using a master equation for sequential tunneling through normal-metal electrodes, we calculate the steady-state current and the phonon distribution of the torsional mode. When the valley-state splitting matches the torsional phonon energy, orbital transitions can drive the mode out of equilibrium. The contacts control both phonon pumping and its electrical readout, allowing substantial excitation with a positive, vanishing, or negative current response. The mechanism requires no intrinsic spin or valley polarization of the electrodes, but uses state-dependent tunneling at the contacts.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了悬浮碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电子驱动。纳米管中的谷态沿着管轴携带相反的轨道磁矩，并且间隔混合形成谷混合本征态，其分裂可以通过轴向磁场控制。我们制定了扭转角速度和谷轨道角动量之间的轨道-旋转耦合。使用通过普通金属电极的顺序隧道效应的主方程，我们计算了扭转模式的稳态电流和声子分布。当谷态分裂与扭转声子能量匹配时，轨道跃迁可以使模式失去平衡。触点控制声子泵浦及其电读数，从而允许以正电流、消失电流或负电流响应进行大量激发。

full_list.title_en: Field theories and critical excitations at anyon condensation transitions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Field theories and critical excitations at anyon condensation transitions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anyon condensation transitions remain challenging to characterize especially when the condensing anyons are non-abelian. We develop two complementary approaches for extracting information about the transition from the categorical data of the parent topological order and the condensate. The first adapts a Ginzburg-Landau procedure developed for 1+1D transitions in the SymTFT setting to 2+1D anyon condensation transitions. The construction applies when the anyons participating in the condensate have integer quantum dimensions. The second gives a criterion for identifying which point and loop excitations become critical at a continuous transition. The key step is to determine which anyon loops remain condensed throughout. All other loops become critical, while a point excitation becomes critical if it braids trivially with every condensed loop. We illustrate both proposals in several abelian and non-abelian examples.

full_list.title_en: Floquet ground state order
full_list.title_zh: Floquet 基态序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28336v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Clean, interacting, periodically driven systems are believed to thermalize to featureless, infinite-temperature states that preclude the formation of stable ordered states. Here, we show stable quantum order, distinct from prethermal order, and its phase transitions in the ground state of the average-energy operator. Decomposing the time evolution into geometric and average-energy dynamics, we apply Geometric Floquet theory to identify the Floquet ground state. We derive a general variational principle to compute the Floquet ground state in large interacting periodically driven systems, and use it to develop a matrix product state algorithm. In driven nonintegrable chains of more than 100 interacting spins, our numerical simulations exhibit a gapped, area-law entangled Floquet ground state in extended parameter regimes; the ground-state manifold can support both dressed equilibrium order (e.g., Floquet antiferromagnets) and inherently nonequilibrium order (e.g., ground-state time crystals). This quantum order is protected by a finite average-energy gap, which closes at phase transition points upon changing model parameters. We decompose Floquet phases of matter into their equilibrium and nonequilibrium elements: whereas the Floquet ground state at any fixed time is a representative of an equilibrium phase of matter, the nonequilibrium content is entirely produced by the drive holonomy and is geometric. Finally, we identify quasilocal counterdiabatic driving as a mechanism for the stability against heating of gapped Floquet ground states in nonintegrable quantum systems, and argue why Floquet ground states evade the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis. Our work enables the study of interacting nonequilibrium matter deep into the many-body regime, and lays the foundations for the engineering of strongly correlated ordered quantum states.
full_list.abstract_zh: 人们认为，清洁、相互作用、周期性驱动的系统会热化到无特征、无限温度状态，从而阻碍稳定有序状态的形成。在这里，我们展示了与热前序不同的稳定量子序，及其在平均能量算子基态下的相变。将时间演化分解为几何和平均能量动力学，我们应用几何 Floquet 理论来识别 Floquet 基态。我们推导了通用变分原理来计算大型交互周期性驱动系统中的 Floquet 基态，并用它来开发矩阵乘积状态算法。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 人们认为，清洁、相互作用、周期性驱动的系统会热化到无特征、无限温度状态，从而阻碍稳定有序状态的形成。在这里，我们展示了与热前序不同的稳定量子序，及其在平均能量算子基态下的相变。将时间演化分解为几何和平均能量动力学，我们应用几何 Floquet 理论来识别 Floquet 基态。我们推导了通用变分原理来计算大型交互周期性驱动系统中的 Floquet 基态，并用它来开发矩阵乘积状态算法。在超过 100 个相互作用自旋的驱动不可积链中，我们的数值模拟在扩展参数范围内展示了有间隙的面积律纠缠 Floquet 基态；基态流形可以支持修饰平衡序（例如，Floquet 反铁磁体）和固有非平衡序（例如，基态时间晶体）。这种量子序受到有限平均能隙的保护，该能隙在改变模型参数时在相变点处关闭。我们将物质的 Floquet 相分解为其平衡和非平衡元素：而任何固定时间的 Floquet 基态都是物质平衡相的代表，非平衡含量完全由驱动完整产生，并且是几何的。最后，我们将准局域反绝热驱动确定为不可积量子系统中带隙 Floquet 基态加热稳定性的机制，并论证了为什么 Floquet 基态回避了本征态热化假说。我们的工作使得能够深入研究多体体系中相互作用的非平衡物质，并为强相关有序量子态的工程奠定基础。

full_list.title_en: Floquet Instability of Photon-Axion Conversion
full_list.title_zh: 光子-轴子转换的Floquet不稳定性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26908v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The discovery of axions would provide evidence for physics beyond the Standard Model. In this work, we investigate axion-photon conversion in the presence of a background magnetic field with simultaneous spatial and temporal periodicity. By performing a Lorentz transformation, the coupled axion-photon system is mapped onto a time-periodic linear system that can be analyzed using Floquet theorem. We find unstable modes associated with resonant crossing between Floquet replicas. The resulting complex Floquet exponents lead to exponentially growing modes, which we identify as a Floquet instability. Then, we determine the parameter regions in which this instability appears in a perturbative analysis. We further show that the Floquet instability enhances the axion-field amplitude generated from an initial photon field. Our results demonstrate that spatiotemporally periodic magnetic backgrounds provide a distinct mechanism for modifying axion-photon conversion through Floquet instability.
full_list.abstract_zh: 轴子的发现将为标准模型之外的物理学提供证据。在这项工作中，我们研究了在具有同时空间和时间周期性的背景磁场存在下的轴子-光子转换。通过执行洛伦兹变换，耦合轴子-光子系统被映射到可以使用 Floquet 定理进行分析的时间周期线性系统。我们发现与 Floquet 复制品之间的共振交叉相关的不稳定模式。由此产生的复杂 Floquet 指数导致指数增长模式，我们将其识别为 Floquet 不稳定性。然后，我们确定在微扰分析中出现这种不稳定性的参数区域。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 轴子的发现将为标准模型之外的物理学提供证据。在这项工作中，我们研究了在具有同时空间和时间周期性的背景磁场存在下的轴子-光子转换。通过执行洛伦兹变换，耦合轴子-光子系统被映射到可以使用 Floquet 定理进行分析的时间周期线性系统。我们发现与 Floquet 复制品之间的共振交叉相关的不稳定模式。由此产生的复杂 Floquet 指数导致指数增长模式，我们将其识别为 Floquet 不稳定性。然后，我们确定在微扰分析中出现这种不稳定性的参数区域。我们进一步表明，Floquet 不稳定性增强了初始光子场生成的轴子场振幅。我们的结果表明，时空周期性磁背景提供了一种通过 Floquet 不稳定性修改轴子-光子转换的独特机制。

full_list.title_en: Fully Automated Wannier Disentanglement via Projectability Selection in Gaussian and Augmented Plane-Wave Frameworks
full_list.title_zh: 通过高斯和增强平面波框架中的可投影性选择实现全自动 Wannier 解缠
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing the frozen manifold for entangled bands requires balancing exact reproduction of the target bands with sufficient variational freedom to build a well-localized subspace from the broader Bloch pool. We present a workflow that systematically determines the energy ceiling for a target number of selected Wannier projections, freezing every Bloch state below this threshold across the sampled k-mesh. By measuring projectability, the spectral weight of each Bloch state projected onto the target localized basis, the workflow detects missing conduction channels and quantifies discrepancies between orbital character and energy-based freezing. In comparisons where we controlled the extent of the energy ceiling, freezing all sub-ceiling states is generally favored over projectability-based frozen states. Of the seven materials we tested, freezing all sub-ceiling states lowers the band error on four from between 11 meV and 1.2 eV to 18 meV or less, and matches the projectability-based choice to within about 2 meV on the remaining three. In each of the four, projectability-based frozen states give the lower spread, showing that spread alone cannot identify the better model. With the frozen states held fixed, the workflow minimizes the gauge-invariant spread, constructs the gauge from density-matrix columns on atomic orbitals, and passes an isolated set of bands to Wannier90 for localization. The workflow is implemented in two programs for seamless high-throughput Wannierization with WIEN2k (wien2wannier) and CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier). Using a single set of calibrated defaults, the CRYSTAL implementation with analytic overlaps produces models that reproduce the reference bands of five cells, from bulk h-BN in a joint valence-and-conduction model to a magnetic framework with 1424 orbitals. The WIEN2k implementation produces eight such models from seven calculations.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：Wannier 插值和有效电子模型，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Gap-Protected Heisenberg-Limited Squeezing with Locally Interacting Multi-Level Spins
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Gap-Protected Heisenberg-Limited Squeezing with Locally Interacting Multi-Level Spins
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.02314v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We demonstrate a general mechanism to generate scalable, metrologically useful entanglement in the form of generalized spin squeezing in multi-level (qudit) spin systems with power-law interactions. We demonstrate this for spin-changing dynamics, extending the physics of spin-nematic squeezing known from spinor BECs to spatially extended lattice geometries. In the absence of all-to-all connectivity, the dynamics generally suffers from leakage into non-collective finite-momentum modes, destroying Heisenberg scaling. We show that introducing local mathfraksu(D) exchange interactions establishes an energy gap that protects the fully symmetric collective manifold, suppressing non-collective excitations, and achieving Heisenberg scaling ξ²propto1/N in one to three dimensions for any power-law exponent. We provide an analytical understanding of the mechanism via the analysis of the Bogoliubov excitation spectrum, and demonstrate its effectiveness via numerical simulations of the quantum many-body dynamics. Our findings more broadly apply to other spin-squeezing Hamiltonians, and directly generalize to larger internal spin dimensions. Our results provide a practical pathway towards scalable Heisenberg-limited qudit entanglement generation in experimental platforms such as arrays of (polar) molecules, magnetic atoms, and Rydberg atoms realizing multi-level spin systems.

full_list.title_en: Giant Spin-to-Charge Conversion by Tailoring Magnetically Proximitized Topological Dirac Semimetal
full_list.title_zh: 通过定制磁邻近拓扑狄拉克半金属实现巨型自旋到电荷转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.17639v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The role of magnetic proximity on topological surface states (TSSs) and spin-to-charge conversion efficiency is studied in Fe/topological Dirac semimetal α-Sn heterostructures. As α-Sn thickness increases (9-38 nm), the damping constant of Fe peaks at 25 nm and then decreases. Theoretical modeling links this to long-range magnetic proximity effects (MPE) that suppress TSSs at the Fe/α-Sn interface while opening an exchange gap at the opposite interface. At 25 nm, we achieve an inverse Edelstein length of -3.1±1.0 nm, one of the highest values at room temperature, highlighting MPE's importance in spintronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在 Fe/拓扑狄拉克半金属 α-Sn 异质结构中研究了磁接近度对拓扑表面态 (TSS) 和自旋电荷转换效率的作用。随着 α-Sn 厚度增加（9-38 nm），Fe 的阻尼常数在 25 nm 处达到峰值，然后下降。理论模型将其与长程磁邻近效应 (MPE) 联系起来，该效应抑制 Fe/α-Sn 界面处的 TSS，同时在相反界面处打开交换间隙。

full_list.title_en: Good-Γ Numbers: A Shell-Optimized Route to the Thermodynamic Limit in Quantum Monte Carlo Calculations of the High-Density Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Good-Γ Numbers: A Shell-Optimized Route to the Thermodynamic Limit in Quantum Monte Carlo Calculations of the High-Density Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-particle finite-size errors remain a central obstacle in quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations of periodic systems, conventionally reduced via twist averaging (TA). Here we introduce Good-Γ (GG) particle numbers as system sizes N at which the Γ-point Hartree--Fock (HF) energy of the high-density two-dimensional uniform electron gas (2D UEG) lies anomalously close to its thermodynamic-limit (TL) value. All results in this work concern the 2D UEG in its high-density Fermi-liquid regime, rₛ=1--4. We systematically investigate the kinetic- and exchange-energy errors, Δ KE(N) and Δ EX(N), that underlie this one-body finite-size-error cancellation across four densities and both spin polarizations. We then compare diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) energies extrapolated to the TL from GG-N sequences against twist-averaged extrapolations at the same densities and polarizations, finding agreement to within a fraction of a millihartree in every case, independent of whether a 1/N or an N⁻⁵/⁴ extrapolation form is used.

full_list.title_zh: 手性拓扑半金属 CoSi 中手性域之间的晶界散射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We evaluate the electron scattering properties in CoSi thin films having either twin (heterochiral) or non-twin (homochiral) grain boundaries using first-principles quantum transport calculations. We find that scattering across a twin grain boundary is more resistive than scattering across a non-twin grain boundary and that non-twin grain boundaries have a greater percentage of surface conduction than twin grain boundaries. This is corroborated by the transmission eigenstate profiles, which show that the surface Fermi-arc electrons can transmit past the non-twin grain boundaries between homochiral domains on the same surface without significant backscattering. In contrast, these surface electrons get scattered along the twin grain boundaries between heterochiral domains to the opposite surface, resulting in partial forward transmission and partial backscattering that yields higher grain-boundary resistivity. This work helps elucidate the complexities of electron transport in chiral topological semimetals for potential application in next-generation nano-interconnects.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用第一原理量子输运计算来评估具有孪晶（异手性）或非孪晶（同手性）晶界的 CoSi 薄膜中的电子散射特性。我们发现，跨越孪晶晶界的散射比跨越非孪晶晶界的散射更具电阻性，并且非孪晶晶界比孪晶晶界具有更大的表面传导百分比。传输本征态分布证实了这一点，该分布表明表面费米弧电子可以传输穿过同一表面上同手性域之间的非孪晶晶界，而不会产生明显的反向散射。相反，这些表面电子沿着异手性域之间的孪生晶界散射到相反的表面，导致部分前向传输和部分后向散射，从而产生更高的晶界电阻率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用第一原理量子输运计算来评估具有孪晶（异手性）或非孪晶（同手性）晶界的 CoSi 薄膜中的电子散射特性。我们发现，跨越孪晶晶界的散射比跨越非孪晶晶界的散射更具电阻性，并且非孪晶晶界比孪晶晶界具有更大的表面传导百分比。传输本征态分布证实了这一点，该分布表明表面费米弧电子可以传输穿过同一表面上同手性域之间的非孪晶晶界，而不会产生明显的反向散射。相反，这些表面电子沿着异手性域之间的孪生晶界散射到相反的表面，导致部分前向传输和部分后向散射，从而产生更高的晶界电阻率。这项工作有助于阐明手性拓扑半金属中电子传输的复杂性，以用于下一代纳米互连的潜在应用。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《手性拓扑半金属 CoSi 中手性域之间的晶界散射》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Heat-current-induced nonreciprocal phonon damping
full_list.title_zh: 热电流引起的不可逆声子阻尼
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.27014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal symmetry enforces equal equilibrium linewidths for time-reversed phonon modes at opposite wave vectors. Here we show that a steady heat current can produce nonreciprocal anharmonic damping even in centrosymmetric nonmagnetic crystals. The effect arises from nonequilibrium occupations of scattering partners, which change the statistical weights of time-reversed three-phonon channels while their squared matrix elements remain equal. Within the single-mode relaxation-time approximation, we derive a linewidth correction that is linear in the temperature gradient and odd under wave-vector reversal. The response depends on scattering-partner velocities and equilibrium lifetimes and retains signed channel weights absent from the equilibrium linewidth. First-principles calculations for centrosymmetric MgO and diamond yield nonzero, mode-dependent linewidth corrections at selected finite wave vectors, demonstrating the mechanism in both ionic and covalent crystals. Reversing the heat current at fixed local temperature exchanges the broadening and narrowing of paired modes. This current-reversible linewidth contrast provides a spectral signature of occupation feedback, with potential implications for nonlinear phonon transport.
full_list.abstract_zh: 时间反演对称性强制相反波矢的时间反演声子模式具有相等的平衡线宽。在这里，我们证明即使在中心对称非磁性晶体中，稳定的热流也可以产生非互易非谐波阻尼。这种效应是由散射伙伴的非平衡占据引起的，它改变了时间反转三声子通道的统计权重，而它们的平方矩阵元素保持相等。在单模弛豫时间近似中，我们得出了线宽校正，该校正在温度梯度中呈线性，在波矢量反转下呈奇数。响应取决于散射伙伴速度和平衡寿命，并保留平衡线宽中不存在的有符号通道权重。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 时间反演对称性强制相反波矢的时间反演声子模式具有相等的平衡线宽。在这里，我们证明即使在中心对称非磁性晶体中，稳定的热流也可以产生非互易非谐波阻尼。这种效应是由散射伙伴的非平衡占据引起的，它改变了时间反转三声子通道的统计权重，而它们的平方矩阵元素保持相等。在单模弛豫时间近似中，我们得出了线宽校正，该校正在温度梯度中呈线性，在波矢量反转下呈奇数。响应取决于散射伙伴速度和平衡寿命，并保留平衡线宽中不存在的有符号通道权重。中心对称 MgO 和金刚石的第一性原理计算在选定的有限波矢量下产生非零、模式相关的线宽校正，证明了离子和共价晶体中的机制。在固定的局部温度下反转热流会交换配对模式的加宽和变窄。这种电流可逆线宽对比提供了占用反馈的光谱特征，对非线性声子传输具有潜在影响。

core_items.title_en: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
core_items.title_zh: 具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验和灵活性
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.28095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across ν=1/5, 1/3, and 2/5, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.
core_items.abstract_zh: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。因此，我们提出了轨道对矩阵因子 MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz，它不仅用可学习的对因子替换固定的 Laughlin 结构，而且使它们依赖于电子构型和轨道，从而平衡物理先验与灵活性。在 ν=1/5、1/3 和 2/5 范围内，MHPO-M 在测试的变体中实现了最低的变分能量，并且基于它的因式分解轨道读数可以扩展到 35 个电子，其能量与从 3-LL 精确对角化结果推断出的趋势具有竞争力。这些结果表明，可以在不牺牲神经网络波函数灵活性的情况下适当地合并物理先验，从而为具有 LL 混合的 FQH 系统的精确、可扩展建模开辟了一条有希望的道路。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验和灵活性》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
core_items.title_zh: MOFFieldBench：金属有机框架中连续电子场的机器学习基准
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.27036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.

core_items.title_en: Generalized Spin Groups and Applications to Magnons
core_items.title_zh: 广义自旋群及其在磁振子中的应用
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.28024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin groups provide the natural symmetry framework for the isotropic Heisenberg model, in which spin and lattice degrees of freedom are separable. They have recently found broad applications in describing electronic band structure, magnon band topology, and transport phenomena. However, a typical spin Hamiltonian describing magnons contains not only isotropic Heisenberg exchange but also anisotropic interactions induced by spin-orbit coupling (SOC), including the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, the Gamma exchange, and the single-ion anisotropy (SIA), which strongly influence magnon properties. More recently, some studies have also revealed relativistic magnon transport phenomena in altermagnets. Such systems typically exhibit partial spin-lattice locking, but are commonly assumed to be described by conventional magnetic groups. Here, we develop a systematic symmetry framework, generalized spin groups, for magnons. We first classify the symmetries of Heisenberg, DM, Gamma, and SIA interactions. The resulting classification contains 6 spin-only groups, together with a total of 161 nontrivial spin groups. The symmetries of magnetically ordered phases are then obtained through spontaneous symmetry breaking of the corresponding parent groups for spin Hamiltonians. We also identify 6 spin-only groups for ordered states, which generate 90, 264, 157, 264, 387, and 598 nontrivial spin groups, respectively. Finally, we apply generalized spin groups to the magnon thermal conductivity and spin conductivity tensors and derive all the symmetry-allowed forms. Our results provide a unified symmetry framework for analyzing magnon transport both with and without SOC, yielding more refined constraints on magnon responses.
core_items.abstract_zh: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。此类系统通常表现出部分自旋晶格锁定，但通常假设由常规磁性基团描述。在这里，我们为磁振子开发了一个系统的对称框架，即广义自旋群。我们首先对 Heisenberg、DM、Gamma 和 SIA 相互作用的对称性进行分类。生成的分类包含 6 个仅自旋组，以及总共 161 个非平凡自旋组。然后通过自旋哈密顿量的相应母群的自发对称破缺获得磁有序相的对称性。我们还确定了有序态的 6 个仅自旋群，它们分别生成 90、264、157、264、387 和 598 个非平凡自旋群。最后，我们将广义自旋群应用于磁振子热导率和自旋电导率张量，并导出所有对称允许的形式。我们的结果提供了一个统一的对称框架，用于分析有和没有 SOC 的磁振子输运，从而对磁振子响应产生更精细的约束。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《广义自旋群及其在磁振子中的应用》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Graph-Theoretic Analysis of Phase Optimization Complexity in Variational Wave Functions for Heisenberg Antiferromagnets
core_items.title_zh: 海森堡反铁磁体变分波函数相位优化复杂度的图论分析
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2602.04943v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the computational complexity of learning the ground state phase structure of Heisenberg antiferromagnets. Representing Hilbert space as a weighted graph, the variational energy defines a weighted XY model that, for Z₂ phases, reduces to a classical antiferromagnetic Ising model on that graph. For fixed amplitudes, reconstructing the signs of the ground state wavefunction thus reduces to a weighted Max-Cut instance. This links sign optimization of wavefunctions directly to combinatorial optimization.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了学习海森堡反铁磁体基态相结构的计算复杂性。将希尔伯特空间表示为加权图，变分能量定义了加权 XY 模型，对于 Z2 相，该模型简化为该图上的经典反铁磁 Ising 模型。对于固定振幅，重建基态波函数的符号因此减少为加权最大割实例。这将波函数的符号优化直接与组合优化联系起来。

core_items.title_en: Lattice symmetry breaking and strain control of single-q magnetism in Na₃Co₂SbO₆
core_items.title_zh: Na₃Co2SbO₆中单q磁性的晶格对称性破缺与应变控制
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.27663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distinguishing single-q from multi-q magnetism constrains microscopic spin Hamiltonians. Here we determine the ground state of the candidate Kitaev magnet Na₃Co₂SbO₆ through its coupling to the lattice. High-resolution neutron diffraction reveals a spontaneous monoclinic-to-triclinic distortion at the magnetic transition, in contrast to the absence of detectable lattice-symmetry breaking in triple-q Na₂Co₂TeO₆. Together with strain-selective magnetic responses, this identifies single-q order in Na₃Co₂SbO₆ over the proposed symmetry-preserving double-q state. Uniaxial compression along a low-symmetry in-plane direction achieves the domain selection that magnetic-field training could not, revealing the intrinsic field-induced phase boundaries of the dominant domain. These results establish strain as a symmetry-conjugate field for magnetic domains and highlight magnetoelastic coupling as a route to diagnose, manipulate, and potentially tune magnetic states.
core_items.abstract_zh: 区分单 q 与多 q 磁性限制了微观自旋哈密顿量。在这里，我们通过与晶格的耦合确定了候选基塔耶夫磁体 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 的基态。高分辨率中子衍射揭示了磁转变时自发的单斜晶向三斜晶畸变，与三q Na2Co2TeO6 中不存在可检测到的晶格对称性破缺相反。与应变选择性磁响应一起，这确定了 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 中所提出的对称性保持双 q 态的单 q 级。沿低对称性面内方向的单轴压缩实现了磁场训练无法实现的域选择，揭示了主域的固有场感应相边界。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Na₃Co2SbO₆中单q磁性的晶格对称性破缺与应变控制》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Quantum Fisher Information in semiclassical magnon systems
core_items.title_zh: 半经典磁子系统中的量子费希尔信息
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2607.20424v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) is a powerful spectroscopic tool to witness many-body quantum entanglement in solid state materials, but it is not always obvious how to relate it to other characteristics of condensed matter systems. In this study we elaborate on the meaning and interpretation of QFI in condensed matter by examining simple theoretical spin systems. We use finite sized spin systems to illustrate that QFI quantifies the momentum- dependent degree of quantum entanglement (that is the entanglement depth at a given wave vector) within a wave function. We subsequently use semiclassical frustrated spin models to show that, in the context of linear spin wave theory (LSWT), QFI quantifies the momentum-dependent degree of magnon squeezing in the ground state. In antiferromagnets with a zero-energy Goldstone mode, LSWT breaks down and QFI (and entanglement depth) diverges at the magnetic ordering wave vector. We also show examples of emergent quantum phases in frustrated spin systems that do not appear in classical phase diagrams. When these emergent phases are approached, QFI diverges across multiple wave vectors in momentum space. Taken together, QFI is not only helpful as a lower bound for entanglement depth, but serves as a momentum-resolved probe of entanglement that offers a novel perspective on quantum critical phenomena.
core_items.abstract_zh: 量子费希尔信息（ QFI ）是一种见证固态材料中多体量子纠缠的强大光谱工具，但如何将其与凝聚态系统的其他特征联系起来并不总是很明显。在本研究中，我们通过检查简单的理论自旋系统来阐述QFI在凝聚态物质中的含义和解释。我们使用有限尺寸的自旋系统来说明QFI量化了波函数内量子纠缠的动量依赖程度（即给定波矢量处的纠缠深度）。随后，我们使用半经典挫折自旋模型来证明，在线性自旋波理论（ LSWT ）的背景下， QFI量化了基态中磁子挤压的动量依赖程度。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 量子费希尔信息（ QFI ）是一种见证固态材料中多体量子纠缠的强大光谱工具，但如何将其与凝聚态系统的其他特征联系起来并不总是很明显。在本研究中，我们通过检查简单的理论自旋系统来阐述QFI在凝聚态物质中的含义和解释。我们使用有限尺寸的自旋系统来说明QFI量化了波函数内量子纠缠的动量依赖程度（即给定波矢量处的纠缠深度）。随后，我们使用半经典挫折自旋模型来证明，在线性自旋波理论（ LSWT ）的背景下， QFI量化了基态中磁子挤压的动量依赖程度。在具有零能量Goldstone模式的反铁磁体中， LSWT分解并且QFI （和纠缠深度）在磁有序波矢量处发散。我们还展示了经典相图中没有出现的挫折自旋系统中出现的量子相的例子。当接近这些紧急阶段时， QFI在动量空间中的多个波向量之间发散。总而言之， QFI不仅有助于作为纠缠深度的下限，而且可以作为纠缠的动量分辨探针，为量子临界现象提供新的视角。

core_items.title_en: Ammonia-Hydrogen Phase Equilibria in Planetary Envelopes from First-Principles-Based Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
core_items.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的机器学习分子动力学研究行星包层中的氨-氢相平衡
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.27136v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ammonia and hydrogen are major constituents of planets within and beyond the solar system, yet how they interact in planetary envelopes is poorly known. We perform large-scale two-phase coexistence simulations of the ammonia-hydrogen system from 500 to 4000 K and 0.1 to 100 GPa, driven by machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory calculations. From these we map the compositions of coexisting hydrogen-rich and ammonia-rich phases, and the critical curve that separates conditions of complete miscibility from those of phase separation. The critical temperature increases with pressure, from 500 K at 0.1 GPa to 2000 K near 30 GPa, and we find no phase separation at 3000 and 4000 K up to 100 GPa. The slope of the critical curve decreases substantially between 0.3 and 30 GPa, and the curve nearly flattens above about 30 GPa and 2000 K, where molecules begin to give way to atomic species. The coexistence curves are asymmetric with an ammonia-rich critical composition. For the expected envelope compositions, the phase boundary lies close to, and intersects, published thermal profiles of Uranus and Neptune, implying ammonia may be raining out in these planets today. In contrast, in warm sub-Neptunes such as TOI-270 d, ammonia and hydrogen are likely miscible in all proportions. Together with previous studies, our results suggest that silicates, water and ammonia separate from hydrogen in sequence as planets cool, with implications for their compositional, thermal and structural evolution.
core_items.abstract_zh: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。临界温度随着压力的增加而增加，从 0.1 GPa 时的 500 K 到接近 30 GPa 的 2000 K，并且我们发现在 3000 和 4000 K 直至 100 GPa 时没有相分离。临界曲线的斜率在 0.3 至 30 GPa 之间大幅下降，并且在约 30 GPa 和 2000 K 以上，曲线几乎变平，此时分子开始让位于原子物种。共存曲线与富含氨的临界成分不对称。对于预期的包络成分，相界位于天王星和海王星已发表的热剖面附近并与之相交，这意味着今天这些行星上可能会下雨。相比之下，在TOI-270 d等温暖的亚海王星中，氨和氢可能以任何比例混溶。结合之前的研究，我们的结果表明，当行星冷却时，硅酸盐、水和氨会依次与氢分离，这对其成分、热和结构演化产生影响。
core_items.summary: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹、第一性原理标注与结构优化、密度泛函理论和电子结构计算。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《基于第一性原理的机器学习分子动力学研究行星包层中的氨-氢相平衡》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
